title.zh: 腔体状态：同配方也会慢慢漂
title.en: Chamber state: the same recipe can drift gradually

subtitle.zh: 清腔 / Seasoning / 腔壁膜层 / 耗材寿命
subtitle.en: Chamber cleaning / seasoning / wall film / consumable lifetime

body.zh: 湿清或换件；去除沉积；更换耗材
body.en: Wet clean or replace parts Remove deposits Replace consumables
Seasoning Establish a stable chamber-wall condition

body.zh: 早期晶圆确认；关注首片；与片间趋势
body.en: Verify early wafers Monitor the first wafer and wafer-to-wafer trends

body.zh: 生产沉积累积；腔壁膜层；逐渐增厚
body.en: Production deposit accumulation Chamber-wall film gradually thickens

body.zh: 结果逐渐漂移；同配方下；片间性能漂移
body.en: Results gradually drift Under the same recipe, wafer-to-wafer performance drifts

body.zh: 清洁或维护；恢复初始状态；进入新循环
body.en: Cleaning or maintenance Restore the initial state and begin a new cycle

body.zh: 清腔后；膜厚/刻蚀分布；腔壁干净；边界条件可控
body.en: After cleaning Film-thickness / etch distribution Clean chamber walls and controlled boundary conditions

body.zh: 稳定区；膜厚/刻蚀分布；形成稳定腔壁膜层；工艺窗口稳定
body.en: Stable regime Film-thickness / etch distribution A stable wall film forms and the process window stabilizes

body.zh: 累积后；膜厚/刻蚀分布；沉积持续累积；腔体边界发生变化
body.en: After accumulation Film-thickness / etch distribution Deposits continue to accumulate and chamber boundaries change

body.zh: 清洁降低沉积与颗粒 ↔ 同时重置腔壁状态
body.en: Cleaning reduces deposits and particles ↔ also resets wall conditions

body.zh: 腔壁温度；•影响膜层沉积/去除；•温度不均会改变边缘状态
body.en: Chamber-wall temperature • Affect film deposition / removal • Temperature nonuniformity changes edge conditions

body.zh: Seasoning条件；•气体种类与流量；•时间与功率设定；•决定腔壁初始膜层特性
body.en: Seasoning conditions • Gas species and flow • Time and power settings • Determine initial wall-film properties

body.zh: 累计片数或等离子时间；•随片数膜层逐渐变化；•影响刻蚀速率与均匀性；• 存在漂移趋势
body.en: Cumulative wafer count or plasma time • Film evolves with wafer count • Affects etch rate and uniformity • A drift trend exists

body.zh: Kit与聚焦环寿命；•耗材磨损/沉积改变间隙；•影响气流与电场分布；• 寿命接近时更易漂移
body.en: Kit and focus-ring lifetime • Wear / deposits change gaps • Affect gas flow and electric-field distribution • Drift becomes more likely near end of life

body.zh: 异常不应自动；触发配方修改
body.en: An abnormality should not automatically trigger a recipe change

body.zh: 量测反馈：；OES与Endpoint/FDC / 片序与PM记录；OES；Endpoint；FDC；片序与PM记录

body.zh: 机制区别；液相反应与气相/等离子体作用有何不同；等离子体；中性气体；离子；湿法；常见RIE
body.en: Mechanism differences How do liquid reactions differ from gas/plasma action? Plasma Neutral gas Ions Wet etch Typical RIE

body.zh: 方向控制；侧壁形状取决于反应与方向性控制；方向性；各向同性；晶面选择性

body.zh: 材料选择；去掉目标层，还要保住其他材料；掩膜；选择性去除；目标层；停止层；刻蚀前；刻蚀后

title.zh: 机制区别：材料怎样被去掉
title.en: Mechanisms: how material is removed

subtitle.zh: 液相反应、活性物种与离子作用。
subtitle.en: Liquid-phase reactions, reactive species and ion action

body.zh: 核心判断；湿法以液相化学反应去除材料；常见RIE依靠化学反应与离子作用协同。；干法还包含气相化学刻蚀、离子束刻蚀等不同机制。
body.en: Core assessment Wet etching removes material through liquid-phase chemistry; typical RIE combines chemical reactions and ion action Dry etching also includes gas-phase chemical etching, ion-beam etching and other mechanisms

body.zh: 流程位置；接收目标膜层及掩膜/暴露区域，完成材料去除，交给后清洗和量测。
body.en: Position in the flow Receive the target film and mask/exposed regions, remove material, then pass to post-clean and metrology

body.zh: 湿法刻蚀（液相化学反应）；反应物在液相中与表面发生化学反应，生成可溶性产物。；刻蚀液；（化学反应物）；可溶性产物；随液流带走；掩膜；Si；各向异性湿法示例；（晶向选择性，侧壁向内倾斜）
body.en: Wet etching (liquid-phase chemical reaction) Reactants chemically react with the surface in liquid to form soluble products Etchant (chemical reactant) Soluble products carried away by liquid flow Mask Si Example of anisotropic wet etching (crystallographic selectivity; inward-sloping sidewalls)

body.zh: 反应离子刻蚀（RIE，反应性干法）；气相活性物种发生化学反应，离子提供能量辅助去除。；中性活性物种；正离子；（化学反应）；（提供能量）；掩膜；挥发性产物；被抽气带走；Si；各向异性干法示例；（化学反应＋离子作用）
body.en: Reactive ion etching (RIE, reactive dry etching) Reactive gas species react chemically while ions supply energy to assist removal Neutral reactive species Positive ions (chemical reaction) (energy supply) Mask Volatile products removed by pumping Si Example of anisotropic dry etching (chemical reaction + ion action)

body.zh: 过程链；该链主要描述湿法与；反应性干法；纯物理；溅射以动量传递去除；材料。
body.en: Process chain This chain mainly describes wet and reactive dry etching; pure physical sputtering removes material through momentum transfer
5 Products are carried away by liquid flow or pumping

body.zh: 关键控制；• 反应物供给；• 表面温度；产物排出；• RIE另需控制离子能量
body.en: Key controls • Reactant supply • Surface temperature Product removal • RIE also requires ion-energy control

body.zh: 耦合与失效；加强离子作用可能促进；去除，也可能增加掩膜；损耗和表面损伤；供给；不足或产物排出不畅可；能造成残留与局部刻蚀；不足。
body.en: Coupling and failure Stronger ion action can promote removal but may also increase mask loss and surface damage; insufficient supply or poor product evacuation may cause residue and local underetch

body.zh: 量测反馈；用膜厚差或台阶深度；估算速率，结合缺陷检；查判断是否去净，支持；复核供给、温控与表面；状态。
body.en: Metrology feedback Estimate rate from film-thickness change or step depth, and inspect defects to determine whether removal is complete; use this to review supply, temperature control and surface condition

body.zh: 下游影响与边界；表面残留会影响后续成；膜、接触或附着；干法；不能全部解释为“靠离；子撞击”。
body.en: Downstream effects and boundaries Surface residue affects subsequent film growth, contacts or adhesion; dry etching cannot always be explained as ion bombardment alone

title.zh: 方向控制：侧壁由什么决定
title.en: Directional control: what determines the sidewall?

subtitle.zh: 纵向去除、横向去除与晶面差异。
subtitle.en: Vertical removal, lateral removal and crystal-plane differences

body.zh: 核心判断；各向异性描述不同方向刻蚀速率的差别；；“干/湿”分类本身不能决定最终侧壁形状。
body.en: Core assessment Anisotropy describes differences in etch rate across directions; the dry/wet classification alone does not determine final sidewall shape

body.zh: 流程位置；把掩膜开口转成目标层轮廓，为后续填充、隔离或结构释放提供几何形状。
body.en: Position in the flow Convert mask openings into target-layer profiles for subsequent fill, isolation or structural release

body.zh: 1；明确目标轮廓；确定所需的沟槽或；通孔形状
body.en: 1 Define the target profile Define the required trench or via shape

body.zh: 2 检查材料与晶向；确认刻蚀材料；及晶向（如Si（100））
body.en: 2 Check material and crystal orientation Confirm the etched material and orientation (e.g. Si(100))

body.zh: 3；匹配反应和；方向控制机制；选择合适的刻蚀方法；与反应条件
body.en: 3 Match the reaction and directional-control mechanism Choose a suitable etch method and reaction conditions

body.zh: 控制刻蚀深度；达到目标；纵向去除量
body.en: Control etch depth Achieve the target vertical removal

body.zh: 5；比对顶部/底部；尺寸及侧壁；确认关键尺寸；与侧壁形貌
body.en: 5 Compare top/bottom dimensions and sidewalls Verify critical dimensions and sidewall profile

body.zh: 方向性干法（如 RIE）；近乎直壁；Si；示例：Cl₂ / HBr；等离子体刻蚀硅
body.en: Directional dry etch (e.g. RIE) Nearly vertical sidewalls Si Example: Cl₂ / HBr plasma etching of silicon

body.zh: 各向同性刻蚀；侧向同时去除；Si；示例：XeF₂气相；刻蚀硅（干法，各向同性）
body.en: Isotropic etching Lateral removal occurs simultaneously Si Example: XeF₂ gas-phase silicon etching (dry, isotropic)

body.zh: 晶面选择性湿法；斜壁（受晶向控制）；（111）；（111）；Si（100）；示例：KOH 溶液；刻单晶硅（湿法，晶面控制）
body.en: Crystal-plane-selective wet etching Sloping walls (controlled by orientation) (111) (111) Si(100) Example: KOH solution etching single-crystal silicon (wet, crystal-plane controlled)

body.zh: 关键控制；纵向深度；横向退缩；侧壁角度；θ；掩膜尺寸损失
body.en: Key controls Vertical depth Lateral recession Sidewall angle θ Mask dimensional loss

body.zh: 耦合与失效；• 在依赖钝化的方向性干法中，侧壁保护不足会；增加侧蚀，过强可能造成开口收缩或底部难刻。；• 深窄结构还可能出现与宽开口不同的刻蚀深度。
body.en: Coupling and failure • In directional dry etching that relies on passivation, insufficient sidewall protection increases lateral etch, while excessive protection can narrow openings or hinder bottom etching • Deep, narrow structures may also etch to different depths from wide openings

body.zh: 下游影响与边界；• 轮廓偏差可能带来填充空洞；或有效尺寸变化。；• XeF₂气相刻硅可各向同性；去除；KOH 刻单晶硅可形成；晶面控制的斜壁，该斜壁；不等同于 RIE的方向性直壁。
body.en: Downstream effects and boundaries • Profile deviations may cause fill voids or changes in effective dimensions • XeF₂ gas-phase silicon etching can remove isotropically; KOH etching of single-crystal silicon can form crystal-plane-controlled slopes; these sloped walls are not equivalent to directional RIE vertical walls

body.zh: 量测反馈；• 用截面 SEM检查；侧壁与底部。；• 用CD 量测比较；刻前刻后关键尺寸。；• 按开口宽度分组；判断形貌偏差。
body.en: Metrology feedback • Use cross-sectional SEM to inspect sidewalls and the bottom • Compare critical dimensions before and after etching by CD metrology • Group by opening width to assess profile deviations

body.zh: 量测结果反馈，优化工艺条件
body.en: Feed metrology results back to optimize process conditions

body.en: Typical sidewall profiles and their determinants

title.zh: 材料选择：刻掉谁，保住谁
title.en: Material selection: what to remove and what to protect

subtitle.zh: 目标层、掩膜、停止层与暴露材料。
subtitle.en: Target layer, mask, stop layer and exposed materials

body.zh: 核心判断；选择比要写清材料对。S = 目标材料刻蚀速率 ÷ 被保护材料刻蚀速率；；相同条件下，S越大，去除相同目标厚度时，被保护材料通常损失越少。
body.en: Core assessment Specify the material pair: S = target-material etch rate ÷ protected-material etch rate Under identical conditions, higher S generally means less protected-material loss for the same target thickness removed

body.zh: 流程位置；在刻蚀前匹配材料堆栈、掩膜和化学体系，保证刻穿目标层后仍有保护余量。
body.en: Position in the flow Match the stack, mask and chemistry before etching so protection remains after clearing the target

body.zh: 选材流程；1；列出所有；暴露材料
body.en: Material-selection flow 1 List all exposed materials

body.zh: 材料堆栈与选择比示意；刻蚀气体 / 液体；掩膜（如SiO₂）；目标层（如Si）；停止层（如Si₃N₄）；衬底
body.en: Material stack and selectivity Etch gas / liquid Mask (e.g. SiO₂) Target layer (e.g. Si) Stop layer (e.g. Si₃N₄) Substrate

body.zh: 刻蚀速率与选择比；对掩膜；S_target/mask；对停止层；S_target/stop；S越大，；被保护材料损失越少。
body.en: Etch rate and selectivity Relative to mask S_target/mask Relative to stop layer S_target/stop As S increases, protected-material loss decreases

body.zh: 过刻导致薄弱处穿透（风险示意）；正常刻穿目标层；停止层仍有余量；目标层已去除；停止层未穿透

body.zh: 关键控制；离子能量及充电相关条件、；化学暴露时间、后清洗强度、；漂洗干燥条件。
body.en: Key controls Ion energy and charging conditions, chemical exposure time, post-clean strength, and rinse/dry conditions

body.zh: 耦合权衡；加强清洗可能减少残留，也可能侵蚀功能膜；；降低离子能量可能减轻损伤，也可能削弱；部分表面去除能力。
body.en: Coupled trade-offs Stronger cleaning may reduce residue but also erode functional films; lower ion energy may reduce damage but also weaken some surface-removal mechanisms

body.zh: 常见失效；干法可能出现离子/充电相关损伤与聚合物残留；；湿法可能出现非目标材料腐蚀，脆弱或悬空结构；还可能在干燥时粘连。
body.en: Common failures Dry etching may cause ion/charging damage and polymer residue; wet etching may corrode nontarget materials, while fragile or suspended structures may also stick during drying

body.zh: 下游影响与边界；损伤与残留可能影响漏电、接触电阻或寿命。；湿法没有等离子体轰击，也不能因此称为“无损伤”；；干燥粘连重点针对脆弱结构，气相释放也需验证；实际工艺条件。
body.en: Downstream effects and boundaries Damage and residue may affect leakage, contact resistance or lifetime Wet etching has no plasma bombardment, but cannot therefore be called damage-free; drying stiction particularly concerns fragile structures, and vapor-phase release also requires validation under actual process conditions

body.zh: 量测反馈；先用缺陷检查和SEM定位，再按疑点选择表面成分分析或电性测试；；依据验证结果决定隔离、复测或工艺改善。
body.en: Metrology feedback First locate defects by inspection and SEM, then choose surface-composition analysis or electrical tests for the suspected issue; use validation results to decide isolation, remeasurement or process improvement

title.zh: 选型逻辑：从结构需求倒推路线
title.en: Selection logic: work backward from structural requirements

subtitle.zh: 材料兼容、目标形貌、损伤预算与总成本。
subtitle.en: Material compatibility, target profile, damage budget and total cost

body.zh: 核心判断：先看技术要求能否满足，再比较整段工艺的成本、产能和稳定性。
body.en: Core assessment: meet technical requirements first, then compare total-flow cost, throughput and stability

body.zh: 流程位置：用于工艺整合与路线评估，；决定采用干法、湿法或两者串联。
body.en: Position in the flow: process integration and route evaluation to choose dry, wet or a combination

body.zh: 决策流程：列材料堆栈 → 定目标形状与去除量 →；查选择比和损伤限制 → 比较后处理与量产条件 →；用代表性结构验证。
body.en: Decision flow: list the material stack → define target shape and removal amount → check selectivity and damage limits → compare post-treatment and production conditions → validate representative structures

body.zh: 关键约束：目标形貌/尺寸、保护层损失预算、；表面及结构耐受性、整段成本与产能。
body.en: Key constraints: target profile/dimensions, protective-layer loss budget, surface and structural tolerance, total-flow cost and throughput

body.zh: 耦合与失效：湿法批量处理可能有吞吐优势，仍需计入；药液、漂洗干燥和材料损失；干法也需计入设备、耗材、；维护与后处理。仅按单步时间选择，可能遗漏结构塌陷、；残膜或下游性能劣化。
body.en: Coupling and failure: batch wet processing may offer throughput advantages, but include chemicals, rinse/dry and material loss; dry processing must include equipment, consumables, maintenance and post-treatment; selecting only by single-step time may miss structural collapse, residual film or downstream performance degradation

body.zh: 场景判断：；细线图形、深孔、；陡直侧壁：；通常优先评估；方向性干法。；方向性干法；（陡直侧壁）
body.en: Scenario assessment Fine patterns, deep holes and steep sidewalls: usually evaluate directional dry etching first Directional dry etch (steep sidewalls)

body.zh: 去除特定暴露膜层：；可评估选择性湿法，；同时核对所有暴露材料。；选择性湿法；（去除特定膜层）
body.en: Remove specific exposed films: evaluate selective wet etching while checking all exposed materials Selective wet etch (remove a specific film)

body.zh: 利用单晶硅晶面成形：；可评估KOH等晶面；选择性湿法。；晶面选择性湿法；（如KOH，斜侧壁）
body.en: Shape single-crystal silicon by crystal planes: evaluate KOH and other crystal-plane-selective wet methods Crystal-plane-selective wet etch (e.g. KOH, sloped sidewalls)

body.zh: 脆弱结构释放：；结合材料选择性与干燥风险，；评估湿法配合适配干燥，；或气相释放。；湿法配合适配干燥；或气相释放（如XeF₂）
body.en: Release fragile structures: combine material selectivity with drying risk; evaluate wet release with suitable drying or vapor-phase release Wet release with suitable drying or vapor-phase release (e.g. XeF₂)
2 Define target shape and removal amount

body.zh: 典型串联示例：干法定义结构 → 适配湿法去膜/清洗；1.干法定义结构；（如刻蚀形成图形）；2.适配湿法去膜/清洗；（清洗与刻蚀目的不同，；也可能改变材料厚度）
body.en: Typical combined route: dry structural definition → compatible wet stripping/cleaning 1. Define structure by dry etching (e.g. etch a pattern) 2. Compatible wet stripping/cleaning (cleaning and etching serve different purposes, and cleaning may also change film thickness)

body.zh: 量测反馈；比较代表性结构的形貌、；材料损失、缺陷、电性和；批间稳定性，据此确认路线。
body.en: Metrology feedback Compare representative profiles, material loss, defects, electrical properties and lot-to-lot stability to confirm the route

body.zh: 形貌；材料损失；缺陷；电性；批间稳定性；反馈优化
body.en: Profile Material loss Defects Electrical properties Lot-to-lot stability Feedback optimization

body.zh: 下游影响与边界：；可按需要串联“干法定义；结构 → 适配湿法去膜/清洗”，；但清洗与刻蚀目的不同，；也可能改变材料厚度。；节点名称和“干/湿”标签；都不足以单独完成选型。
body.en: Downstream effects and boundaries Combine dry structural definition with suitable wet stripping/cleaning as needed, but cleaning and etching have different purposes and cleaning may change film thickness Node names and dry/wet labels are insufficient on their own for selection

title.zh: 芯片制造里的可靠性有哪些参数？
title.en: Which reliability parameters matter in chip manufacturing?

subtitle.en: Common reliability metrics for devices, interconnects and packages

body.zh: 栅氧在电场作用下发生击穿
body.en: Gate oxide breaks down under an electric field

body.zh: 金属互连中原子迁移导致失效
body.en: Atomic migration in metal interconnects causes failure

body.zh: 测试：大电流密度＋高温应力
body.en: Test: high current density + high-temperature stress

body.zh: 静电放电造成器件瞬时损伤
body.en: Electrostatic discharge causes instantaneous device damage

body.zh: 偏压与温度导致阈值电压漂移
body.en: Bias and temperature shift threshold voltage

body.zh: 电源分布不均导致电压下降
body.en: Uneven power distribution causes voltage drop

body.zh: 评估：版图＋仿真/ 测量
寄生PNPN结构被触发导致大电流
body.en: Triggered parasitic PNPN structure produces high current

body.zh: 热载流子注入栅氧导致退化
body.en: Hot carriers injected into gate oxide cause degradation

body.zh: 测试：高场 ＋ 高温偏压应力
body.en: Test: high field + high-temperature bias stress

body.zh: 热胀冷缩导致封装/焊点疲劳
body.en: Thermal expansion and contraction fatigue packages / solder joints

body.zh: 指标：循环次数/裂纹 /失效
吸湿导致回流时“爆米花”现象
body.en: Absorbed moisture causes popcorn cracking during reflow

body.zh: 指标：吸湿量/ 爆米花等级
可靠的芯片 = 可用、耐用、值得信赖！
body.en: Reliable chips = usable, durable and trustworthy!

title.zh: 薄膜工程：厚度只是第一关
title.en: Thin-film engineering: thickness is only the first hurdle

subtitle.zh: Uniformity、Conformality、Stress、Interface与Particle
subtitle.en: Uniformity, conformality, stress, interface and particles

body.zh: 1；表面预处理；去除有机物/氧化层；活化表面
body.en: 1 Surface pretreatment Remove organics / oxide and activate the surface

body.zh: 2；成核；物种到达表面；形成成核位点
body.en: 2 Nucleation Species reach the surface and form nucleation sites

body.zh: 3；薄膜生长；持续供给与反应；薄膜逐步生长
body.en: 3 Film growth Continuous supply and reaction grow the film progressively

body.zh: 4；Purge/；副产物排出；排出副产物与过量前驱体；准备下一步/稳定生长
body.en: 4 Purge / byproduct removal Remove byproducts and excess precursor to prepare the next step / stabilize growth

body.zh: 5；后处理与；膜质检查；退火/致密化（可选）；膜质与厚度检查
body.en: 5 Post-treatment and film-quality inspection Anneal / densify (optional) Inspect film quality and thickness

body.zh: PVD：物理输运，方向性较明显；Target；溅射/蒸发等物理输运，直线性路径，；对深孔/高深宽比覆盖受限。
body.en: PVD: physical transport with stronger directionality Target Physical transport such as sputtering/evaporation follows line-of-sight paths, limiting coverage in deep holes and high-aspect-ratio features

body.zh: CVD：气相反应与表面成膜；气体扩散至表面，表面反应生成薄膜，；覆盖性优于PVD，受扩散与反应限制。
body.en: CVD: gas-phase reaction and surface film formation Gas diffuses to the surface and reacts to form a film; coverage is better than PVD, limited by diffusion and reaction

body.zh: ALD：表面自限反应，循环生长；前驱体A；前驱体B；交替脉冲与吹扫，表面自限反应，；原子层级生长，覆盖性最佳。
body.en: ALD: self-limiting surface reactions and cyclic growth Precursor A Precursor B Alternating pulses and purges create self-limiting surface reactions, atomic-scale layer growth and best coverage

body.zh: 理想的共形覆盖（高深宽比沟槽）；侧壁与底部厚度一致，无空隙、无缝隙覆盖。
body.en: Ideal conformal coverage (high-aspect-ratio trench) Equal sidewall and bottom thickness, without voids or seams

body.zh: 薄膜厚度均匀性（Wafer Map 示例）；Thickness (Å)；1200；1050；900；750；600；良好（±2%）；较差（±8%）
body.en: Film-thickness uniformity (wafer-map example) Thickness (Å) 1200 1050 900 750 600 Good (±2%) Poor (±8%)
Five core metrics Thickness Uniformity Conformality Stress Interface

body.zh: 三组Trade-off；Temperature ↑：膜质可能改善；Thermal Budget ↑
body.en: Three trade-offs Temperature ↑: film quality may improve Thermal budget ↑

body.zh: Conformality ↑：复杂结构；覆盖改善；Throughput/成本压力
body.en: Conformality ↑: better coverage of complex structures Throughput / cost pressure

body.zh: Stress控制：；附着与翘曲之间平衡
body.en: Stress control: balance adhesion against warpage
Common failures Pinhole Seam Void Particle Delamination Thickness nonuniformity

body.zh: 方法边界；PVD、CVD与ALD机理；不同，不能用同一套；固定步骤和优缺点解；释所有薄膜。
body.en: Method boundaries PVD, CVD and ALD have different mechanisms, so a single set of fixed steps and advantages/disadvantages cannot explain every film

body.zh: 量测反馈：Thickness Map / Stress / Sheet R/ Composition / XSEM；Ellipsometer /；Reflectometry
body.en: Metrology feedback: thickness map / stress / sheet R / composition / XSEM Ellipsometer / reflectometry

body.zh: 优化工艺与条件选择；（前驱体/功率/压力/；温度/时间/流量等）
body.en: Optimize process and condition selection (precursor / power / pressure / temperature / time / flow, etc.)
Impact: Etch window Interconnect resistance Leakage CMP Reliability

body.zh: 材料类型（示例）；Dielectric（SiO₂ / SiN / HfO₂ / Al₂O₃ 等）；Metal（Cu/W/ Al/Co等）；Barrier（TaN /TiN 等）；Seed （Cu Seed / Ru Seed 等）/ Functional Film （a-Si/ SiGe / High-k/ Ferroelectric 等）；*非穷尽列举
body.en: Material types (examples) Dielectric (SiO₂ / SiN / HfO₂ / Al₂O₃, etc.) Metal (Cu / W / Al / Co, etc.) Barrier (TaN / TiN, etc.) Seed (Cu seed / Ru seed, etc.) / functional films (a-Si / SiGe / high-k / ferroelectric, etc.) *Non-exhaustive list

notes.en: The source broadly states better CVD coverage than PVD and best ALD coverage, while also noting method/material boundaries. These statements are retained without extending them to all conditions.

title.zh: 掺杂与热预算：注入后还要激活
title.en: Doping and thermal budget: activation is needed after implantation

subtitle.zh: Dose、Energy、Angle、Activation与Diffusion
subtitle.en: Dose, energy, angle, activation and diffusion

body.zh: 1 掩膜准备；SiO₂；Si；• 薄膜/光刻形成掩膜；• 开口定义掺杂区域；• 掩膜材料与厚度影响；角度/选择性（Shadowing），
body.en: 1 Mask preparation SiO₂ Si • Form the mask by thin-film deposition / lithography • Openings define doped regions • Mask material and thickness affect angle / selectivity (shadowing)

body.zh: 2 离子注入；离子源；（B, P, As, BF₂⁺ 等）；质量分析；选择；加速电场；加电场；（Tilt）；旋转；（Rotation）；• 离子经加速后穿过掩膜进入硅中；• Tilt-Rotation 减少沟道效应与不均匀；• 能量决定穿透深度，剂量决定注入量
body.en: 2 Ion implantation Ion source (B, P, As, BF₂⁺, etc.) Mass analysis Selection Accelerating electric field Applied electric field (Tilt) Rotation (Rotation) • Accelerated ions pass through the mask and enter silicon • Tilt–rotation reduces channeling and nonuniformity • Energy determines penetration depth; dose determines implanted amount

body.zh: 3 去胶/清洗；Rp（投影射程）；深度；Si；• 去除光刻胶与残留物；• 避免有机残留造成缺陷；或污染
body.en: 3 Strip / clean Rp (projected range) Depth Si • Remove resist and residue • Avoid defects caused by organic residue or contamination

body.zh: 4 退火激活；高温退火（RTA/Spike/炉管等）；掺杂原子（已占位）；硅原子；晶格空位/缺陷；• 修复注入损伤：间隙/空位消除；• 掺杂原子占据替位 → 电学激活；• 同时发生扩散 → 结加深与展宽；并非所有注入的离子都会被电学激活
body.en: 4 Anneal activation High-temperature anneal (RTA / spike / furnace, etc.) Dopant atom (occupying a site) Silicon atom Lattice vacancy / defect • Repair implantation damage: remove interstitials / vacancies • Dopants occupy substitutional sites → electrical activation • Diffusion occurs simultaneously → deeper, broader junctions Not all implanted ions become electrically active

body.zh: • 电学量測评估掺杂效果；•验证片电阻、接触电阻、；结深/结形貌等；• 反馈工艺调整
body.en: • Assess doping by electrical measurements • Verify sheet resistance, contact resistance, junction depth/profile, etc. • Feed back process adjustments

body.zh: 2 物理量要分清；Dose → 注入总量
body.en: 2 Distinguish physical quantities Dose → total implanted amount

body.zh: Energy → 深度分布；浓度；深度
Activation + Diffusion；→ 最终有效掺杂与结形貌；浓度；---注入后（未退火）；退火后（有效掺杂）；深度
body.en: Activation + diffusion → final effective doping and junction profile Concentration After implantation (unannealed) After annealing (effective doping) Depth

body.zh: 3 耦合权衡；更温退火：；Activation与修复 ↑；Diffusion与；Thermal Budget ↑；两者需要平衡
body.en: 3 Coupled trade-offs Source phrase: warmer annealing Activation and repair ↑ Diffusion and thermal budget ↑ The two must be balanced

body.zh: 4 常见失效；Channeling（沟道效应）；Shadowing（阴影效应）；注入污染（Contamination）；激活不足（Under-Activation）；Junction Broadening（结展宽）；浓度；深度
body.en: 4 Common failures Channeling Shadowing Implantation contamination Under-activation Junction broadening Concentration Depth

body.zh: 量测反馈：；Sheet Resistance / SIMS / WAT
body.en: Metrology feedback: Sheet resistance / SIMS / WAT

body.zh: Sheet Resistance（四探针 Rs）；高Rs；低Rs；•片内均匀性与趋势
body.en: Sheet resistance (four-point Rs) High Rs Low Rs • Within-wafer uniformity and trends

body.zh: SIMS（深度剖析）；浓度；（对数）；深度；•掺杂浓度-深度分布（定性示意）
body.en: SIMS (depth profiling) Concentration (log scale) Depth • Dopant concentration versus depth (qualitative schematic)

body.zh: WAT（电学量测）；I-V曲线；C-V曲线；TLM 接触电阻；R_T；• 器件/结构电学特性验证
body.en: WAT (electrical metrology) I–V curve C–V curve TLM contact resistance R_T • Validate device/structure electrical characteristics

body.zh: 反馈调整工艺选择；调整 Dose；调整 Energy；调整 Anneal；（温度-时间）
body.en: Adjust the process through feedback Adjust dose Adjust energy Adjust anneal (temperature–time)

body.zh: 影响：Vt / Contact Resistance / Leakage / Junction Reliability
body.en: Impact: Vt / contact resistance / leakage / junction reliability

body.zh: 不同掺杂元素、晶向、器件结构和节点会采用不同注入与退火策略。
body.en: Different dopants, crystal orientations, device structures and nodes use different implantation and annealing strategies

notes.zh: 原图写“更温退火”和“加电场（Tilt）”，文字可能不规范；保留可见文字，不擅自改成特定退火条件或偏转电场术语。

title.zh: 清洗与平坦化：管理表面和地形
title.en: Cleaning and planarization: manage surfaces and topography

subtitle.zh: Particle、Metal、Residue、Surface State与Planarity
subtitle.en: Particles, metal, residue, surface state and planarity

body.zh: 清洗 | 控制污染与表面状态；确认来料表面；Particles（颗粒）；Organics（有机物）；Metals（金属离子）；Residue（残留物）；表面存在多种污染
body.en: Cleaning: control contamination and surface condition Confirm incoming surface Particles Organics Metals (metal ions) Residue Multiple contaminants exist on the surface

body.zh: 化学/物理清洗；化学反应/机械作用；去除污染物
body.en: Chemical / physical cleaning Chemical reactions / mechanical action remove contaminants

body.zh: DI漂洗；去除化学残留；和松散颗粒
body.en: DI rinse Remove chemical residue and loose particles

body.zh: 干燥；去除水分，仍可能；残留少量颗粒/痕迹
body.en: Dry Remove water, while some particles / marks may remain

body.zh: 表面检查；检测并评估表面状态，；仍有残留/缺陷可能
body.en: Inspect the surface Inspect and assess surface condition; residue / defects may still remain

body.zh: 颗粒；有机物残留；金属残留；残留物/薄膜；潜在缺陷/风险
body.en: Particles Organic residue Metal residue Residue / film Potential defect / risk

body.zh: CMP |优先去除高处实现平坦化；前序沉积后；（有地形差异）；前序沉积填充后，；仍存在地形起伏
body.en: CMP: preferentially remove high regions to planarize After preceding deposition (with topographic differences) After deposition and fill, topographic relief remains

body.zh: Pad/Slurry接触；压力；Pad与Slurry接触，；化学+机械作用；开始去除材料
body.en: Pad / slurry contact Pressure Pad and slurry contact; chemical + mechanical action begins removing material

body.zh: 优先去除高处；高处受力/反应更强，；去除速率更高；；低处去除较少
body.en: Preferential removal of high regions Higher regions see stronger force/reaction and higher removal rates; lower regions lose less material

body.zh: 接近终点；（共面化）；高处被去除后，；表面趋于共面
body.en: Approach endpoint (coplanarity) After high regions are removed, the surface approaches coplanarity

body.zh: Post-CMP Clean；（去除残留）；去除残留Slurry、；金属离子与颗粒
body.en: Post-CMP clean (remove residue) Remove residual slurry, metal ions and particles

body.zh: 平坦化结果；表面达到全局平坦，；地形差异显著降低
body.en: Planarized result The surface becomes globally planar, substantially reducing topographic differences

body.zh: CMP负责去除高处，不负责填充低处；低处填充发生在前序沉积。
body.en: CMP removes high regions; it does not fill low regions, which are filled during preceding deposition

body.zh: 上层薄膜；阻挡层/硬掩膜；介质层（ILD）；金属层；衬底
body.en: Upper film Barrier / hard mask Dielectric (ILD) Metal layer Substrate
1 Cleaning controls Particle Metal Residue Surface state
2 CMP controls Removal rate WIWNU Selectivity Endpoint

body.zh: 3 耦合权衡；清洗能力 ↑；Surface Damage/；Corrosion风险可能 ↑
body.en: 3 Coupled trade-offs Cleaning capability ↑; surface damage / corrosion risk may ↑
Removal rate ↑; scratch / dishing / erosion risk may ↑

body.zh: 前序Fill质量 → 决定CMP余量；与Void暴露风险
body.en: Previous fill quality → determines CMP margin and risk of exposing voids
4 Common failures Watermark Particle Corrosion Scratch Dishing Erosion

body.zh: 量测反馈：Defect Map / Thickness / Topography / Surface Analysis；Defect Map；（缺陷分布）；> 100；50-100；10-50；1-10
body.en: Metrology feedback: defect map / thickness / topography / surface analysis Defect map (defect distribution) >100 50–100 10–50 1–10

body.zh: 影响：；Adhesion / Lithography Focus / Overlay / Contact R / Yield
body.en: Impact: Adhesion / lithography focus / overlay / contact resistance / yield

body.zh: 清洗化学、Slurry、Pad 与Endpoint策略会随材料体系、结构和Fab政策变化。
body.en: Cleaning chemistry, slurry, pad and endpoint strategies vary with materials, structures and fab policy

body.zh: 2 Inline量测；输出：厚度/ CD / Overlay；Thickness；CD；Overlay

body.zh: 5；Containment/；Root Cause；隔离受影响范围；证据链（数据+样品+日志）；根因分析（人/机/料/法/环）；制定并执行缓解措施
body.en: 5 Containment / root cause Contain the affected scope Evidence chain (data + samples + logs) Root-cause analysis (people / machine / material / method / environment) Define and execute mitigation actions

body.zh: 6 WAT与Yield验证；输出：电学表现 ＆ Yield趋势；WAT（例：Id-Vg）；Yield趋势（按Lot）；回到工艺窗口（Process Window）

body.zh: 1 采样与量测基础；• Sampling；•GRR；•Repeatability；• Reproducibility；重复性；再现性；总变异；目标：量测稳定、可区分过程变化
body.en: 1 Sampling and metrology fundamentals • Sampling • GRR • Repeatability • Reproducibility Repeatability Reproducibility Total variation Goal: stable metrology that distinguishes process changes

body.zh: 2 控制界限要分清；Control Limit：；过程波动判断；Spec Limit：；产品要求；两者不是同一个概念
body.en: 2 Distinguish control boundaries Control limit: assess process variation Specification limit: product requirement These are different concepts

body.zh: 3 关键Trade-off；• Sampling密度 ↑：；检出能力 ↑；Cost与；Cycle Time ↑
body.en: 3 Key trade-offs • Sampling density ↑: detection capability ↑; cost and cycle time ↑

body.zh: • Inline指标异常 ≠；最终器件必然失效
body.en: • An abnormal inline metric ≠ inevitable final-device failure

body.zh: 4 常见失效；False Alarm；异常逃逸；采样盲区；量测漂移；未验证就改Recipe
body.en: 4 Common failures False alarm Escaped anomaly Sampling blind spot Metrology drift Changing the recipe without validation

body.zh: 诊断；证据链；时间趋势；Wafer空间分布；Tool/Chamber分层；独立量测；工程判断；• 复测/离线量测；• 交叉工具验证

title.zh: 岗位与解题：协作比背答案重要
title.en: Roles and problem solving: collaboration matters more than memorized answers

subtitle.zh: Process、Equipment、PIE、Yield与Metrology怎样协同
subtitle.en: How process, equipment, PIE, yield and metrology work together

body.zh: Process：；Recipe与工艺窗口；•定义Recipe与参数范围；• 工艺窗口与风险评估；• 变更评估与DOE设计
body.en: Process: Recipe and process window • Define recipe and parameter ranges • Assess process window and risk • Assess changes and design DOE

body.zh: PIE：；Module Integration；与产品CTQ；• CTQ定义与失效机理分析；• 失效定位与结构表征；•与设计/封装协同闭环
body.en: PIE: Module integration and product CTQ • Define CTQ and analyze failure mechanisms • Localize failures and characterize structures • Close the loop with design / packaging

body.zh: Equipment：；Tool / Chamber/PM；• Tool状态与稳定性管理；•PM计划与执行；•异常隔离与维修验证
body.en: Equipment: Tool / chamber / PM • Manage tool condition and stability • Plan and execute PM • Contain anomalies and validate repairs

body.zh: Yield：；Defect / WAT/；Yield Correlation；• 缺陷监控与WAT分析；• Yield Correlation建模；• 风险预警与优先级排序
body.en: Yield: Defect / WAT / yield correlation • Monitor defects and analyze WAT • Model yield correlation • Warn of risks and prioritize

body.zh: Metrology：；量测能力与数据可信度；• 量测方法学与校准；•数据质量与不确定度；•量测趋势与异常确认
body.en: Metrology: Measurement capability and data credibility • Metrology methodology and calibration • Data quality and uncertainty • Confirm measurement trends and anomalies
Evidence chain Observations Data and logs Samples Analysis Conclusion

body.zh: 注：岗位名称与职责边界；会随公司与Fab组织方式变化，；协同目标是共同找出根因并；稳定量产。
body.en: Note: role names and responsibility boundaries vary with company and fab organization; the common goal is to find the root cause and stabilize production

body.zh: 六步解题流程；1；发现异常；SPC报警/趋势异常；超规/ 警报触发
body.en: Six-step problem-solving flow 1 Detect the anomaly SPC alarm / abnormal trend Specification breach / alarm trigger

body.zh: Containment；立即管控；Hold Lot / 限制流片；评估影响范围
body.en: Containment Immediate containment Hold lot / restrict processing Assess affected scope

body.zh: 收集日志与样品；RF/FDC；Logs；RF / FDC Logs；报警记录/事件时间线；样品（片/截面/颗粒）
body.en: Collect logs and samples RF / FDC Logs RF / FDC logs Alarm records / event timeline Samples (wafer / cross section / particles)

body.zh: 按Lot/Tool/；Chamber/时间分层；Lot；Tool；Chamber；Time；分层矩阵视图；定位异常集中区间；缩小搜索空间
body.en: Stratify by lot / tool / chamber / time Lot Tool Chamber Time Stratification matrix Locate the concentration of anomalies and narrow the search space

body.zh: Split实验或；维修验证；Repaired；Chamber；A/B Split实验；或维修后验证；对比结果
body.en: Split experiment or repair validation Repaired chamber A/B split experiment or post-repair validation Compare results

body.zh: 标准化与防复发；更新Control Plan；标准化作业与监控；防复发措施落地
body.en: Standardize and prevent recurrence Update the control plan Standardize operations and monitoring Implement recurrence-prevention actions
1 Four key stratifications Lot Tool–chamber Recipe version Material–PM–seasoning

body.zh: 2 核心Trade-off；快速恢复；产能；保留Root；Cause证据
body.en: 2 Core trade-off Rapid recovery of throughput Preserve root- cause evidence

body.zh: 改动变量越多，；归因能力越弱
body.en: The more variables change, the weaker causal attribution becomes

body.zh: 3 常见解题误区；相关性当因果；无Baseline；一次改多个参数；忽略PM状态；忽略量测误差
body.en: 3 Common troubleshooting mistakes Treating correlation as causation No baseline Changing multiple parameters at once Ignoring PM state Ignoring measurement error

body.zh: 4 证据可信度阶梯；现象；相关性；可重复Split；独立量测；机制闭环
body.en: 4 Evidence-credibility ladder Observation Correlation Repeatable split Independent measurement Mechanistic closure

body.zh: 量测反馈：SPC / FDC与Logs / Defect Map / XSEM/ WAT；SPC/趋势；FDC与Logs；Defect Map；XSEM / 分析；RF/ FDC Logs；报警/事件；WAT / 电性
body.en: Metrology feedback: SPC / FDC and logs / defect map / XSEM / WAT SPC / trends FDC and logs Defect map XSEM / analysis RF / FDC logs Alarms / events WAT / electrical properties

body.zh: 影响：Cycle Time / Availability / Yield / Recurrence
body.en: Impact: cycle time / availability / yield / recurrence

title.zh: 退火，不只是把晶圆加热
title.en: Annealing is more than heating a wafer

subtitle.en: How do furnace, RTA, Spike, Flash and Laser differ?

body.zh: 从激活、修复到相变与钝化
body.en: From activation and repair to phase change and passivation

body.zh: 同一峰温不等于同一热预算
body.en: The same peak temperature does not imply the same thermal budget

body.zh: 批量均温，但热预算更大
body.en: Batch temperature uniformity, but a greater thermal budget

body.zh: 单片快升快降，兼顾反应与扩散
body.en: Rapid single-wafer heating and cooling balance reaction and diffusion

body.zh: 峰值近零驻留，抢激活、控扩散
body.en: Almost zero dwell at the peak: activate dopants while controlling diffusion

body.zh: 毫秒级大面积表面加热
局部超快，但更怕光学差异
body.en: Ultrafast local heating, but greater sensitivity to optical differences
N₂, Ar, O₂ and forming gas play different roles

body.zh: 形成气氧化修复；还原钝化
body.en: Forming gas Oxidative repair; reductive passivation

body.zh: 物理稳定；界面优化；缺陷修复
body.en: Physical stability; interface optimization; defect repair
Close the loop with Rs, SIMS and electrical results

body.zh: 目标受限条件设备能力工艺风险工艺方案量测验证

title.zh: 退火做什么：热是手段，材料变化才是目的
title.en: What annealing does: heat is the means; material change is the goal

subtitle.zh: 激活、修复、扩散、相变、致密化与界面钝化
subtitle.en: Activation, repair, diffusion, phase change, densification and interface passivation

body.zh: 退火是多种热处理任务的统称，不同任务需要不同温度轨迹。
body.en: Annealing is a collective term for thermal-processing tasks; different tasks require different temperature trajectories.

body.zh: 激活掺杂掺杂原子进入电活性晶格位置
body.en: Dopant activation Dopant atoms occupy Electrically active lattice sites

body.zh: 修复晶格原子重排与缺陷复合，恢复周期性
body.en: Lattice repair Atomic rearrangement and defect Recombination restore periodicity

body.zh: 控制扩散调控掺杂或杂质的空间分布
body.en: Diffusion control Control the spatial distribution Of dopants or impurities

body.zh: 形成新相发生相变或生成新结构相
body.en: New-phase formation A phase change occurs or A new structural phase forms

body.zh: 薄膜致密化孔隙减少，原子堆积更致密
body.en: Film densification Fewer pores; atoms Pack more densely

body.zh: 界面钝化缺陷与悬键减少，界面态被钝化
body.en: Interface passivation Fewer defects and dangling bonds; Interface states are passivated

body.zh: 明确材料初态• 结构/成分/缺陷• 掺杂分布• 既有应力与相态
body.en: Establish the initial material state • Structure / composition / defects • Dopant distribution • Existing stress and phase state

body.zh: 确定目标变化• 选择期望的材料变化• 设定关键指标方向• 定义可接受的副作用
body.en: Define the target change • Select the desired material change • Define the direction of key metrics • Define acceptable side effects

body.zh: 检查热预算•允许的热负荷上限• 与前道/后道的兼容• 关键层的热稳定性
body.en: Check the thermal budget • Upper limit of permissible thermal load • Compatibility with preceding / subsequent processes • Thermal stability of critical layers

body.zh: 选择气氛与加热方式• 气氛类型与纯度• 压力范围• 加热方式选择
body.en: Select the ambient and Heating method • Ambient type and purity • Pressure range • Heating-method selection

body.zh: 升温/驻留/冷却•升温阶段•高温驻留阶段•冷却阶段
body.en: Heating / dwell / cooling • Heating stage • High-temperature dwell stage • Cooling stage

body.zh: 量测确认• 与目标对比• 判定是否达成• 决定是否迭代
body.en: Confirm by metrology • Compare against the target • Determine whether it has been achieved • Decide whether to iterate

body.zh: 峰值温度决定可激活能量、扩散驱动力与相变可能性。
body.en: Peak temperature Determines available activation energy, Diffusion driving force and the possibility Of phase change.

body.zh: 有效时间影响反应充分性与扩散深度，存在临界与饱和效应。
body.en: Effective time Affects reaction completeness and Diffusion depth, with threshold And saturation effects.

body.zh: 升降温速率影响热应力、相变路径与缺陷生成/消除。
body.en: Heating and cooling rates Affect thermal stress, Phase-transformation paths and Defect generation / elimination.

body.zh: 气氛与压力影响氧化还原、挥发/沉积平衡与界面化学。
body.en: Ambient and pressure Affect redox reactions, Evaporation / deposition equilibrium And interface chemistry.

body.zh: 耦合与权衡（相互制约）激活增强掺杂扩散
body.en: Couplings and tradeoffs (mutual constraints) Stronger activation Dopant diffusion

body.zh: 反应充分团聚/ 应力 / 界面反应
body.en: Complete reaction Agglomeration / stress / interfacial reaction

body.zh: 说明：局部最优不一定等于整合最优，需在多目标之间权衡。
body.en: Note: a local optimum is not necessarily an integration optimum; multiple objectives require tradeoffs.

body.zh: 潜在风险（并非必然发生）激活不足扩散过深残余晶格缺陷薄膜开裂金属团聚
body.en: Potential risks (not inevitable) Insufficient activation Excessive diffusion depth Residual lattice defects Film cracking Metal agglomeration

body.zh: 风险水平取决于材料体系、热轨迹与工艺窗口。
body.en: Risk depends on the material system, thermal trajectory and process window.

body.zh: 量测反馈：Rs / Hall · SIMS · TEM / XRD · C–V / I–V
body.en: Metrology feedback: Rs / Hall · SIMS · TEM / XRD · C–V / I–V

body.zh: 下游影响（器件层面）结深接触电阻阈值电压漏电可靠性良率
body.en: Downstream effects (device level) Junction depth Contact resistance Threshold voltage Leakage Reliability Yield

body.zh: 退火可按热源、温度轨迹、气氛或工艺目的命名，类别可能交叉。
body.en: Annealing may be named by heat source, temperature trajectory, ambient or process purpose; categories may overlap.

title.zh: 温度时间地图：峰温相同，结果也可能完全不同
title.en: Temperature–time map: identical peak temperatures can produce very different results

subtitle.zh: 峰值温度、有效时间、升降温与热穿透共同决定热预算
subtitle.en: Peak temperature, effective time, heating / cooling and thermal penetration jointly determine the thermal budget

body.zh: 热预算不是简单的“温度×时间”；反应、扩散和缺陷演化对温度通常呈强烈非线性。
body.en: The thermal budget is not simply “temperature × time”; reaction, diffusion and defect evolution usually depend strongly and nonlinearly on temperature.

body.zh: 温度-时间工程地图（同一峰温，不同轨迹）
body.en: Temperature–time engineering map (same peak, different trajectories)

body.zh: 炉管：缓慢升降温＋长平台
body.en: Furnace: Slow heating / cooling + long plateau
RTP Soak: Rapid heating + short plateau
Spike: A sharp peak with almost no intentional dwell

body.zh: 晶圆深度剖面（相对趋势示意）炉管/Soak→热进入更深、体内更接近平衡
body.en: Wafer-depth profiles (relative trends) Furnace / Soak → heat penetrates deeper, And the bulk approaches equilibrium

body.zh: Flash/Laser→表层瞬态升温、热穿透更浅
body.en: Flash / Laser → transient surface heating, With shallower thermal penetration

body.zh: 注意：以上为相对趋势，非固定深度。
body.en: Note: these are relative trends, not fixed depths.

body.zh: 热处理选型流程（六步法）
关键可控参数（四张控制卡）
峰值温度决定反应驱动力与部分缺陷活化概率。
body.en: Peak temperature Determines the reaction driving force and Some defect-activation probabilities.

body.zh: 阈值以上有效时间直接影响反应量、扩散与缺陷演化。
body.en: Effective time above The threshold Directly affects reaction extent, Diffusion and defect evolution.

body.zh: Ramp与Quench影响热穿透、热应力与尾巴贡献。
body.en: Ramp and Quench Affect thermal penetration, Thermal stress and the tail contribution.

body.zh: 吸收率/发射率与热穿透决定能量耦合效率与热在材料中的分布。
body.en: Absorptivity / emissivity And thermal penetration Determine energy-coupling efficiency and Heat distribution within the material.

body.zh: 时间更短→扩散更少，但可能需要更高峰温；
body.en: Shorter time → Less diffusion, But a higher peak may be required;

body.zh: 峰温更高→反应更快，但均匀性与材料兼容风险上升。
body.en: Higher peak temperature → Faster reaction, But greater uniformity and material- Compatibility risks.

body.zh: 冷却尾巴也会贡献热预算
body.en: The cooling tail also contributes to the thermal budget

body.zh: 主要风险点温度量测偏差影响真实热预算的判断。
body.en: Principal risks Temperature-measurement bias Affects assessment of the actual Thermal budget.

body.zh: 局部过热引发缺陷、相变或界面异常。
body.en: Local overheating Causes defects, phase changes Or interfacial anomalies.

body.zh: Pattern Loading导致局部温度与反应差异。
body.en: Pattern Loading Causes local temperature And reaction differences.

body.zh: 热应力/翘曲影响形稳、CD与良率稳定性。
body.en: Thermal stress / warpage Affects shape stability, CD And yield stability.

body.zh: 数据反馈更新模型优化候选温度轨迹
body.en: Data feedback Update the model Optimize candidate Temperature trajectories

body.zh: 后续热预算余量（工艺窗口）
分钟、秒、毫秒、纳秒仅用于相对分类，不能直接当作量产Recipe窗口。
body.en: Minutes, seconds, milliseconds and nanoseconds are only relative categories; they cannot be used directly as production Recipe windows.

title.zh: 炉管退火：慢而深，适合批量热处理
title.en: Furnace annealing: slow and deep, suited to batch thermal processing

subtitle.zh: 批量均匀性、深度热处理与总热预算
subtitle.en: Batch uniformity, deep thermal processing and total thermal budget

body.zh: 炉管的优势是批量处理和长时间均温，但持续时间更长，扩散与材料兼容风险也更高。
body.en: Furnace advantages are batch processing and prolonged temperature uniformity, but longer duration also increases diffusion and material-compatibility risks.

body.en: • Prolonged uniform temperature enables deeper heating and more extensive diffusion

body.zh: •气氛在不同区段变化，可能引发氧化/ 还原/污染差异
body.en: • Ambient differences between zones can cause differences in oxidation / reduction / contamination

body.zh: 缓慢升温Soak保温受控降温时间

body.zh: 炉管退火典型流程（六步）

body.zh: 关键控制要点（决定均匀性与重现性）
炉内温度均匀性• 区间温度一致性• 轴向与径向均匀• 热场校准与验证
body.en: Temperature uniformity inside the furnace • Temperature consistency between zones • Axial and radial uniformity • Thermal-field calibration and validation

body.zh: Ramp/ Soak时间•升温斜率平缓• 保温窗口稳定• 降温受控可重复

body.zh: 气体纯度与流场•气体纯度稳定• 流场均匀覆盖•气氛切换可控
body.en: Gas purity and flow field • Stable gas purity • Uniform flow coverage • Controllable ambient switching

body.zh: 舟位与批间匹配• 舟位热差评估•批间匹配一致•装载方式标准化
body.en: Boat-position and batch matching • Assess thermal differences by boat position • Consistent batch matching • Standardized loading

body.zh: 批量吞吐＋深度均温• 批量处理效率高• 均温时间更充分• 适合深度反应与扩散
body.en: Batch throughput + deep temperature equilibration • High batch-processing efficiency • More time for equilibration • Suited to deep reactions and diffusion

body.zh: 更大的扩散、应力和污染累积风险• 扩散与界面反应更充分（可能过深）• 应力累积与翘曲风险上升（视材料）• 污染累积可能性增加（视气氛与材料）
body.en: Greater accumulated diffusion, stress and contamination risks • More extensive diffusion and interfacial reaction (potentially too deep) • Greater accumulated stress and warpage risk (material dependent) • Greater potential contamination accumulation (ambient and material dependent)

body.zh: 慢并不等于差；任务若需要长时间反应或批量均温，炉管仍有优势。
body.en: Slow does not mean poor; furnaces retain advantages for long reactions or batch temperature equilibration.

body.zh: 常见风险（视材料、配方与控制而定，不一定发生）

body.en: Furnace processing is not inherently low-end; suitability depends on reaction depth, diffusion tolerance, the material stack and capacity strategy.

title.zh: Spike退火：到达峰值后立即降温
title.en: Spike annealing: cool immediately after reaching the peak

subtitle.zh: 高激活与低扩散之间的尖锐窗口
subtitle.en: A narrow window between high activation and low diffusion

body.zh: Spike是温度轨迹，不是独立热源；通常由RTP平台实现。
body.en: Spike describes a temperature trajectory, not a separate heat source; it is usually implemented on an RTP platform.
The heating stage Still contributes to the thermal budget

body.zh: 峰值附近近零刻意驻留
body.en: Near the peak Almost no intentional dwell
The cooling tail Still contributes to the thermal budget

body.zh: 气氛稳定确保工艺气氛与压力稳定
body.en: Ambient stabilization Ensure stable process ambient and pressure

body.zh: 快速升温受控升温，减少驻留累积
body.en: Rapid heating Controlled heating reduces accumulated dwell

body.zh: 接近目标峰温精准到达目标峰值附近
body.en: Approach the target peak temperature Precisely reach the vicinity of the target peak

body.zh: 无刻意驻留峰值附近不做额外停留
body.en: No intentional dwell No additional hold near the peak

body.zh: 快速Quench +量测迅速冷却并开展计量验证
body.en: Rapid Quench + metrology Cool rapidly and perform metrology validation

body.zh: PeakTemperature影响激活与扩散的驱动力与窗口
body.en: Peak Temperature Affects the driving forces and process window For activation and diffusion

body.zh: 峰值附近有效时间越短越好，降低扩散与缺陷风险
body.en: Effective time Near the peak The shorter the better, reducing Diffusion and defect risks

body.zh: Ramp/ Quench斜率与对称性决定热预算与缺陷生成
body.en: Ramp / Quench Slope and symmetry determine The thermal budget and defect generation

body.zh: 片内均匀性与发射率影响片内温差，进而影响一致性
body.en: Within-wafer uniformity And emissivity Affect within-wafer temperature differences And therefore consistency

body.zh: 掺杂激活与扩散的耦合平衡
body.en: Coupled balance of dopant activation and diffusion

body.zh: Spike更尖锐有利于压缩扩散
body.en: A sharper Spike Helps suppress diffusion
• Almost zero dwell near the peak

body.zh: • 更陡峭的浓度廓线（总掺杂分布更陡）
body.en: • Steeper concentration profile (steeper total dopant distribution)

body.zh: 目标：在可行窗口内取得更好平衡
body.en: Goal: a better balance within the feasible window
Risks when the balance is lost

body.zh: •过短/过低：激活不足，残余缺陷或不稳定
body.en: • Too short / too low: insufficient activation, Residual defects or instability

body.zh: •过高/局部热点：扩散增加、漏电上升、材料或界面损伤
body.en: • Too high / local hot spots: increased diffusion, Higher leakage and material or interface damage

body.zh: Rs偏高或不均接触电阻恶化
body.en: High or nonuniform Rs Degraded contact resistance

body.zh: 残余扩展缺陷影响可靠性

body.en: Increased junction leakage Degraded off-state behavior

body.en: Metrology feedback: Rs / Hall · SIMS / SRP · TEM · junction leakage / WAT

body.zh: TEM /截面缺陷观察缺陷与界面质量
body.en: TEM / cross-sectional defect observation Defect and interface quality

body.zh: 结漏电 /WAT电学泄漏与可靠性
body.en: Junction leakage / WAT Electrical leakage and reliability
Feedback narrows the Peak and Quench windows

body.zh: 源漏/浅结激活（如S/D、LDD等浅结）
body.en: Source / drain and shallow-junction activation (e.g. shallow S/D and LDD junctions)

body.zh: 部分HKMG界面热处理（界面质量与陷阱调控）

title.zh: 气氛与整合：温度相同，化学反应可能完全不同
title.en: Ambient and integration: identical temperatures can produce entirely different chemistry

subtitle.zh: 惰性、氧化、还原与氢钝化不能混用
subtitle.en: Inert protection, oxidation, reduction and hydrogen passivation are not interchangeable

body.zh: 退火气氛不仅防污染，还可能参与氧化、还原、氮化、相形成或界面缺陷钝化。
body.en: Annealing ambients prevent contamination and may also participate in oxidation, reduction, nitridation, phase formation or interface-defect passivation.

body.zh: N₂ / Ar常用于惰性保护与减少非目标反应
body.en: N₂ / Ar Commonly used for inert protection And reducing unintended reactions

body.zh: O₂ / 氧化性气氛用于受控氧化或调整界面
body.en: O₂ / oxidizing ambient Used for controlled oxidation Or interface modification

body.zh: 形成气Forming Gas含氢气氛，用于部分界面缺陷钝化
body.en: Forming gas Forming Gas A hydrogen-containing ambient used for Passivation of some interface defects

body.zh: 真空 / 低压降低部分气相反应，但需控制挥发和残留
body.en: Vacuum / low pressure Reduces some gas-phase reactions, But evaporation and residues must be controlled

body.zh: 专用反应气氛按材料执行氮化、还原或特定界面处理
body.en: Dedicated reactive ambient Used for material-specific nitridation, Reduction or interface treatment

body.zh: 术语卡：Forming Gas Anneal=气氛+工艺目的，不是与RTA、Flash、Laser并列的热源类别。
body.en: Terminology: Forming Gas Anneal = ambient + process purpose; It is not a heat-source category parallel to RTA, Flash or Laser.

body.zh: 在不同热处理平台中采用合适气氛
body.en: Use appropriate ambients on different thermal-processing platforms

body.zh: 其他适配平台按材料与安全条件确认
body.en: Other compatible platforms Confirm material and safety compatibility
Confirm the material stack And target

body.zh: 气体纯度高纯气体与洁净管路减少引入杂质风险。
body.en: Gas purity High-purity gases and clean lines Reduce the risk of introducing impurities.

body.zh: O₂ H₂O残余O₂ / H₂O影响氧化、羟基化、氢化等反应路径。
body.en: O₂ H₂O Residual O₂ / H₂O Affect oxidation, hydroxylation, Hydrogenation and other reaction pathways.

body.zh: 流量/压力与流场影响传质、温度分布与界面反应均匀性。
body.en: Flow / pressure and flow field Affect mass transfer, temperature distribution And interfacial-reaction uniformity.

body.zh: 氢安全、材料兼容与冷却气氛关注材料相容性、金属腐蚀及冷却阶段气氛。
body.en: Hydrogen safety, material compatibility And cooling ambient Consider material compatibility, metal Corrosion and the ambient during cooling.

body.zh: 形成气可能降低部分界面陷阱效果依材料而变，并需权衡氢稳定性、金属兼容和薄膜应力。
body.en: Forming gas may reduce some interface traps The effect depends on the material; tradeoffs include Hydrogen stability, metal compatibility and film stress.

body.zh: 惰性气氛可减少非目标氧化不会自动完成界面钝化或目标化学反应。
body.en: Inert ambients can reduce unintended oxidation They do not automatically passivate interfaces or Complete the target chemical reaction.

body.zh: 风险取决于材料、泄漏、气体纯度与热轨迹。
body.en: Risk depends on Materials, leaks, Gas purity and The thermal trajectory.

body.zh: 量测反馈：XPS / SIMS · FTIR · C–V / G–V · 接触电阻 · 膜应力
body.en: Metrology feedback: XPS / SIMS · FTIR · C–V / G–V · contact resistance · film stress

body.zh: 同一种气氛在不同金属、介质、节点和热处理平台上，作用与窗口都可能不同。
body.en: The same ambient can have different effects and process windows for different metals, dielectrics, nodes and thermal-processing platforms.

body.en: Laser enables rapid local or very shallow heating, but reflectivity, pattern density and scan overlap directly change the temperature distribution.

body.zh: 重叠过多中心过热，效率下降

title.zh: 选型与量测：退火结果必须用器件指标闭环
title.en: Selection and metrology: close the annealing loop with device metrics

subtitle.zh: 任务、热深度、材料堆叠与量测结果共同决定方案
subtitle.en: Task, thermal depth, material stack and metrology results jointly determine the approach

body.zh: 最快或最高温的方案不一定最好；局部工艺最优也可能损害下游整合与可靠性。
body.en: The fastest or hottest approach is not necessarily best; a locally optimal process may harm downstream integration and reliability.

body.zh: A. 激活/修复要求：扩散容限、晶格缺陷与目标 Rs
body.en: A. Activation / repair Requirements: diffusion tolerance, lattice defects And target Rs

body.zh: B. 相形成/硅化物要求：相组成、接触电阻与团聚窗口
body.en: B. Phase formation / silicides Requirements: phase composition, contact resistance And agglomeration window

body.zh: C. 致密化/应力要求：膜密度、收缩与机械应力
body.en: C. Densification / stress Requirements: film density, shrinkage And mechanical stress

body.zh: D. 界面钝化要求：Dit、漏电、材料与气氛兼容
body.en: D. Interface passivation Requirements: Dit, leakage, materials And ambient compatibility

body.zh: 需要全厚度还是表层/局部加热？
body.en: Is full-depth, surface or local heating required?

body.zh: 膜堆叠是否对光学吸收敏感？
body.en: Is the film stack sensitive to optical absorption?
What ambient can the material tolerate?

body.zh: 组合流程（例如：预退火+SpikeRTA + Laser …）
body.en: Combined flow (e.g. pre-anneal + Spike, RTA + Laser …)

body.zh: 必须进行 Split 与DOE，以验证多种组合对目标与整合的影响；数据驱动选择，而非直觉。
body.en: Split and DOE are required to validate how combinations affect targets and integration; select using data rather than intuition.

body.zh: 明确目标指标• 器件/电学• 结构/界面• 工艺 /整合
body.en: Define target metrics • Device / electrical • Structure / interface • Process / integration

body.zh: 列出热预算与材料限制• 总热预算• 堆叠/厚度• 材料/气氛边界
body.en: List the thermal budget and Material constraints • Total thermal budget • Stack / thickness • Material / ambient boundaries

body.zh: 选择热源/轨迹/气氛• 热源与脉冲特征• 温度轨迹（相对）• 气氛与工艺顺序
body.en: Select the heat source / Trajectory / ambient • Heat-source and pulse characteristics • Temperature trajectory (relative) • Ambient and process sequence

body.zh: Split 与 DOE• 因子/水准设定•Split/阻断设计• 数据记录
body.en: Split and DOE • Factor / level settings • Split / blocking design • Data recording

body.zh: Inline 量测• 关键指标监控• 趋势/漂移•异常预警
body.en: Inline metrology • Monitor key metrics • Trends / drift • Early warning of anomalies

body.zh: WAT/可靠性反馈• 结构/电学验证• 应力/缺陷• 可靠性测试
body.en: WAT / Reliability feedback • Structural / electrical validation • Stress / defects • Reliability testing

body.zh: SPC 维持与异常处置• 控制图监控• 异常处置流程• 经验沉淀
body.en: SPC maintenance and Exception handling • Control-chart monitoring • Exception-handling procedure • Accumulated experience

body.zh: 闭环回流：反馈驱动迭代，可回到步骤2或3优化方案
body.en: Closed-loop return: feedback drives iteration; return to step 2 or 3 to optimize the approach

body.zh: 激活率与结深□ 回片Rs / Hall□ 掺杂活化率□ 结深/侧向扩散□ 缺陷密度
body.en: Activation rate and junction depth □ Returned-wafer Rs / Hall □ Dopant activation fraction □ Junction depth / lateral diffusion □ Defect density

body.zh: 相组成与应力□ 相组成（比例/纯度）□ 接触电阻/比接触电阻□ 团聚/粒径分布□ 薄膜应力/弯曲
body.en: Phase composition and stress □ Phase composition (fraction / purity) □ Contact resistance / specific contact resistance □ Agglomeration / grain-size distribution □ Film stress / bending

body.zh: 片内/片间均匀性□ Wafer内均匀性□ Wafer间一致性□ 批间漂移趋势□ 边缘/中心差异
body.en: Within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer uniformity □ Within-wafer uniformity □ Wafer-to-wafer consistency □ Lot-to-lot drift trend □ Edge / center differences

body.zh: 缺陷与界面电学□ 缺陷类型/密度□ Dit/界面态□ 漏电/击穿特性□ 介质完整性
body.en: Defects and interface electrical characteristics □ Defect type / density □ Dit / interface states □ Leakage / breakdown behavior □ Dielectric integrity

body.zh: 耦合权衡（没有免费午餐）
低Rs可能伴随扩散或漏电
body.en: Low Rs May accompany diffusion or leakage

body.zh: 反应充分，可能伴随团聚或应力
body.en: Complete reaction may accompany agglomeration or stress

body.zh: 更低Dit，仍需验证材料与长期稳定性
body.en: Lower Dit still requires validation of material and long-term stability

body.zh: 常见风险（先识别，后决策）
只看单一指标，忽略多项耦合
body.en: Focusing on one metric and overlooking multiple couplings

body.zh: 温度校准偏差，导致判定失真
腔体/光学不匹配，结果不可迁移
body.en: Chamber / optical mismatch prevents transferring results

body.zh: 边缘异常未识别，造成大面积风险
body.en: Unrecognized edge anomalies create large-area risk

body.zh: 抽样不足，统计意义不足
排查设备 / 材料/环境因素
评估风险并决定是否触发工程变更
body.en: Assess risk and decide whether to trigger an engineering change

body.zh: 记录处置与再验证结果
body.en: Record corrective actions and revalidation results

body.zh: Rs / Hall判断对象：激活程度、载流子浓度迁移率、片内均匀性
body.en: Rs / Hall Assesses: Activation, carrier concentration, Mobility and within-wafer uniformity

body.zh: SIMS / SRP判断对象：掺杂浓度分布、结深、侧向扩散
body.en: SIMS / SRP Assesses: Dopant concentration distribution, Junction depth and lateral diffusion

body.zh: TEM / XRD / Raman判断对象：晶相组成、晶粒尺寸、缺陷与应力
body.en: TEM / XRD / Raman Assesses: Crystal-phase composition, grain size, Defects and stress

body.zh: C-V/I-V判断对象：界面态（Dit）、漏电、击穿与钝化效果
body.en: C–V / I–V Assesses: Interface states (Dit), leakage, Breakdown and passivation results

body.zh: WAT / 可靠性判断对象：器件性能分布、寿命、漂移与稳定性
body.en: WAT / reliability Assesses: Device-performance distribution, lifetime, Drift and stability

body.zh: 性能分布影响时序、驱动、噪声、能效与功能窗
body.en: Performance distribution Affects timing, drive, noise, Energy efficiency and functional windows

body.zh: 接触良率影响硅化物/接触电阻、导通损耗与可靠性
body.en: Contact yield Affects silicidation / contact resistance, Conduction loss and reliability

body.zh: 漏电影响静态功耗、发热、可靠性与寿命
body.en: Leakage Affects static power, heat, Reliability and lifetime

body.zh: 可靠性影响 TDDB、NBTI、HTRB等失效率/寿命
body.en: Reliability Affects TDDB, NBTI, HTRB and other failure rates / lifetimes

body.zh: 剩余热预算影响后续工艺选择、材料稳定性与整合空间
body.en: Remaining thermal budget Affects subsequent process choices, Material stability and integration flexibility

body.zh: 量产流程可能采用预退火+Spike、RTA + Laser等组合；不能假设整片晶圆只能选择一种退火方法。
body.en: Production flows may combine pre-anneal + Spike or RTA + Laser; do not assume that an entire wafer must use only one annealing method.

body.zh: 确认量测有效性与校准状态
body.en: Confirm metrology validity and calibration status

notes.en: The small control-card label “returned-wafer Rs/Hall” is retained from the source; its typography is small and may reflect the source wording.

title.zh: 量测闭环：从电容值走到可靠性
title.en: Measurement loop: from capacitance to reliability

subtitle.zh: C、G、I、频率、温度与时间缺一不可

body.zh: 一次点测只能回答此刻多大，不能证明全窗口与全寿命合格
body.en: A single-point measurement gives the current value; it does not establish compliance over the full operating window and lifetime
• High frequency probes intrinsic dielectric response
• Too small gives poor signal-to-noise ratio

body.zh: • 选择线性区内合适幅度
body.en: • Choose a suitable amplitude in the linear range

body.zh: • 过慢可能引发损伤/漂移
• 温度影响电容、损耗与可靠性

body.zh: • 寄生需正确去嵌与建模
• 结构差异带来系统性误差
应力过低可能看不出薄弱点；应力过高又可能改变或损伤被测结构

body.zh: 窗口内：放行并持续监控
body.en: Within window: release and continue monitoring

body.zh: 趋势预警：复核与加密监控

body.zh: 边界：生产WAT、器件建模与可靠性认证的测试结构和条件并不完全相同。

title.zh: 选型边界：没有万能冠军
title.en: Selection limits: no universal champion

subtitle.zh: 从应用约束反推器件，而不是先选器件再解释
subtitle.en: Derive the device choice from application constraints instead of explaining an already chosen device

body.zh: 精密线性通常优先评估MIM；需要明显C-V变化或调谐时可评估MOS，但最终以PDK为准
body.en: Evaluate MIM first for precision linearity; evaluate MOS for substantial C–V variation or tuning, but ultimately follow the PDK

body.zh: 精密模拟/采样保持/ DAC
综合评估，不按单项冠军选
body.en: Assess all requirements; do not select a single-metric champion
ESR, area and available layers together

body.zh: C-V平坦度、匹配来源（工艺/版图/底板寄生）
body.en: C–V flatness and matching sources (process/layout/bottom-plate parasitics)

body.zh: 电压依赖性小，调谐能力有限
与电极层与介质相关，需核对可用层与密度
body.en: Depends on electrode layers and dielectric; check available layers and density

body.zh: 耐压与介质可靠性限制
介质损耗、ESR、走线与底板寄生
body.en: Dielectric loss, ESR, routing and bottom-plate parasitics

body.zh: 电极层可用性、层成本与布线资源占用
body.en: Electrode-layer availability, layer cost and routing-resource use

body.zh: C-V曲线形状、匹配来源（工艺/版图/衬底）
C-V范围、可调区与非线性代价
body.en: C–V range, tunable region and nonlinearity cost

body.zh: 与器件结构与偏压相关，需核对密度
body.en: Depends on device structure and bias; verify density

body.zh: 反型/弱反型/累积区限制与穿隧风险
通道/衬底损耗、ESR、走线与衬底寄生
body.en: Channel/substrate loss, ESR, routing and substrate parasitics

body.zh: 器件层与衬底连接成本、布线与Guard策略
body.en: Device-layer and substrate-connection cost, routing and guard strategy

body.zh: 带宽/中心频率偏移、Q下降
面积增加、热与可靠性风险
body.en: Increased area, thermal and reliability risks

body.zh: 验证闭环：模型 / PEX/ Corner / Monte Carlo / 硅后测试
body.en: Validation loop: models / PEX / corners / Monte Carlo / post-silicon tests

body.zh: 边界：最终结论必须服从具体PDK器件选项、设计规则、模型覆盖范围与可靠性手册。
body.en: Scope: final conclusions must follow the specific PDK device options, design rules, model coverage and reliability manual.

title.zh: 收尾闭环：去掉还是留下
title.en: Closing the loop: remove it or leave it?

subtitle.zh: 是否Strip取决于Hard Mask后续是否仍有功能与整合价值
subtitle.en: Whether to Strip depends on whether the Hard Mask still has functional or integration value downstream

body.zh: Hard Mask不是天然“临时层”；；有的需选择性去除，有的会保留到后续步骤。
body.en: A Hard Mask is not inherently a “temporary layer”;; some require selective removal, while others remain for later steps.

body.zh: Target Etch完成；问题1：；Hard Mask后续是否仍；承担功能或保护作用？
body.en: Target Etch complete; Question 1:; Will the Hard Mask still; provide function or protection?

body.zh: 否 → Strip Route（去除路线）；是 → Retain Route（保留路线）。
body.en: No → Strip Route; yes → Retain Route.
Confirm HM material and Target / Stop Layer

body.zh: 选择Dry /Wet / Ash等适用去除类别；（依据材料与结构特点评估）
body.en: Choose a suitable removal class: Dry / Wet / Ash; (Assess by material and structure)

body.zh: 控制Removal Selectivity；（对Target / Stop Layer与侧壁的选择性）
body.en: Control Removal Selectivity; (Selectivity relative to Target / Stop Layer and sidewalls)

body.zh: Residue / Surface / CD检查；（残留、表面、关键尺寸检查）
body.en: Residue / Surface / CD inspection; (Inspect residue, surface and critical dimensions)

body.zh: 风险：；•HM Residue• Target Attack；• Corrosion；•Re-deposition
body.en: Risks:; • HM Residue • Target Attack; • Corrosion; • Re-deposition

body.zh: 确认HM作为功能层、保护层或后续整合层；（明确其必要性与角色）
body.en: Confirm its role as a functional, protective or downstream integration layer; (Define its necessity and role)

body.zh: 检查应力与污染；（薄膜应力、颗粒、污染风险）
body.en: Check stress and contamination; (Film stress, particles and contamination risks)

body.zh: 检查后续Deposition / Contact兼容性；（界面兼容与工艺整合性）
body.en: Check subsequent Deposition / Contact compatibility; (Interface compatibility and process integration)

body.zh: 保留HM进入下一模块；（作为功能或保护层使用）
body.en: Retain the HM into the next module; (Use as a functional or protective layer)

body.zh: Electrical / Interface验证；（电性、界面质量验证）
body.en: Electrical / Interface validation; (Validate electrical properties and interface quality)

body.zh: 风险：•界面附着；• 接触电阻；• 污染；• 应力累积
body.en: Risks: • Interface adhesion; • Contact resistance; • Contamination; • Accumulated stress

body.zh: 去除能力增加；Residue；可能下降
body.en: Stronger removal capability; Residue; may decrease

body.zh: 但风险可能上升：；Target / Stop Layer /；Sidewall Damage；与Corrosion风险
body.en: But risks may increase:; Target / Stop Layer /; Sidewall Damage; and Corrosion risk
Hard Mask; Target Layer; Stop Layer

body.zh: 注意：更强的去除能力并不一定更好，需综合考虑选择性、残留、表面状态与下游兼容性。
body.en: Note: stronger removal is not necessarily better; consider selectivity, residue, surface condition and downstream compatibility together.
Feedback to HM material, Target Etch and the Strip / Retain decision

body.zh: Deposition Adhesion；• 附着力降低；• 膜层剥离风险

body.zh: Contact / Via Resistance；• 接触电阻升高；• 导通性能下降

body.zh: Gap Fill / Void Risk；•填充不良；• 空洞风险

body.zh: Yield / Reliability；• 良率下降；• 可靠性变弱
body.en: Yield / Reliability; • Lower yield; • Weaker reliability

body.zh: Metal、 Carbon与Dielectric Hard Mask的去除和保留路线不可互换；；必须依据具体材料、Target与后续模块判断。
body.en: Removal and retention routes for Metal, Carbon and Dielectric Hard Masks are not interchangeable;; decisions must use the specific material, Target and downstream module.

title.zh: 同叫Barrier，拦的不是同一种风险
title.en: Both are called barriers, but they block different risks

subtitle.zh: W偏向化学与成核界面；Cu偏向扩散与连续导电
subtitle.en: W emphasizes chemistry and nucleation interfaces; Cu emphasizes diffusion and continuous conduction

body.zh: W Plug / Contact；Si；Ti： 附着 / 吸杂 / 接触控制；TiN：抑制反应 / 成核界面；W：主体填充
body.en: W plug / contact Si Ti: adhesion / gettering / contact control TiN: reaction suppression / nucleation interface W: bulk fill

body.zh: 主要威胁；WF₆相关反应；成核与覆盖；接触电阻
body.en: Main threats WF₆-related reactions Nucleation and coverage Contact resistance

body.zh: Cu Dual Damascene；Low-k；TaN:Cu扩散阻挡；Ta：界面衔接；Cu Seed： 连续导电路径
body.en: Cu dual damascene Low-k TaN: Cu diffusion barrier Ta: interface transition Cu seed: a continuous conductive path

body.zh: 主要威胁；Cu向介质扩散；Seed断裂；界面可靠性
body.en: Main threats Cu diffusion into the dielectric Seed discontinuity Interface reliability

body.zh: W要填得进去且界面稳；Cu要铜不跑出去且导电不中断
body.en: W must fill the opening with a stable interface; Cu must stay confined with uninterrupted conduction

body.zh: W；向内成核；与覆盖；稳住界面
body.en: W Inward nucleation and coverage Stabilize the interface

body.zh: Cu；阻止向外扩散；保持连续导电；稳住电流路径
body.en: Cu Prevent outward diffusion Maintain continuous conduction Stabilize the current path

title.zh: Ti/TiN不是同一种Barrier
title.en: Ti and TiN are not the same kind of barrier

subtitle.zh: 位置相邻，但每一层解决的问题不同
subtitle.en: They are adjacent, but each layer solves a different problem

body.zh: 介质层；Ti（附着层）；TiN（阻挡 / 成核界面）；W成核层；Bulk W（主体填充）；接触底部/ 基底
body.en: Dielectric Ti (adhesion layer) TiN (barrier / nucleation interface) W nucleation layer Bulk W (main fill) Contact bottom / substrate

body.zh: Ti | 抓住界面；提升附着，吸杂，；并参与接触控制
body.en: Ti | secure the interface Improve adhesion and getter impurities, and contribute to contact control

body.zh: 2；TiN |隔开反应；抑制WF₆相关反应，；形成连续阻挡；WF₆等；反应物
body.en: 2 TiN | isolate reactions Suppress WF₆-related reactions, forming a continuous barrier WF₆ and other reactants

body.zh: 3；W成核|铺好起点；让后续W从连续；表面开始生长
body.en: 3 W nucleation | establish a starting surface Allow subsequent W growth to begin on a continuous surface

body.zh: 4；Bulk W | 完成填充；占据孔内主体；导电体积
body.en: 4 Bulk W | complete the fill Occupy the main conductive volume inside the opening

body.zh: 错误理解；Ti与 TiN只是两层相同的Barrier；Ti；TiN；把两层当作作用相同、可互换
body.en: Misconception Ti and TiN are merely two identical barrier layers Ti TiN Treating both layers as equivalent and interchangeable

body.zh: 正确理解；Ti管附着与接触；TiN管隔离与成核界面
body.en: Correct interpretation Ti manages adhesion and contact; TiN manages isolation and the nucleation interface

body.zh: 介质层；Ti（附着层）；提升附着，参与接触控制
body.en: Dielectric Ti (adhesion layer) Improve adhesion and contribute to contact control

body.zh: TiN（阻挡 / 成核界面）；抑制反应，形成连续阻挡
body.en: TiN (barrier / nucleation interface) Suppress reactions and form a continuous barrier

body.zh: W成核层；提供连续表面，启动生长
body.en: W nucleation layer Provide a continuous surface to initiate growth

body.zh: Bulk W（主体填充）；提供导电体积，完成填充
body.en: Bulk W (main fill) Provide the conductive volume to complete the fill

body.zh: 看层栈不能只背材料名，要看它夹在哪两个界面之间

title.zh: Cu Barrier、Seed和电镀必须连续衔接
title.en: Cu barrier, seed and electroplating require continuous interfaces

subtitle.zh: Dual Damascene不是单层沉积，而是一条连续界面链
subtitle.en: Dual damascene is a continuous interface chain, not a single deposition

body.zh: Via / Trench；刻蚀形成互连结构；Low-k；介质
body.en: Via / trench Etch the interconnect structure Low-k Dielectric

body.zh: Clean / Pre-clean；去残留，活化底部与侧壁
body.en: Clean / pre-clean Remove residues and activate the bottom and sidewalls

body.zh: TaN / Ta；先阻挡Cu扩散，再衔接Seed界面；TaN；（阻挡层）；Ta；（衔接层）
body.en: TaN / Ta Block Cu diffusion first, then prepare the seed interface TaN (barrier layer) Ta (transition layer)

body.zh: Cu Seed；建立连续导电种子层；Cu Seed；（种子层）
body.en: Cu seed Establish a continuous conductive seed layer Cu seed (seed layer)

body.zh: ECP Cu + Anneal；电镀填充，再稳定晶粒与应力
body.en: ECP Cu + anneal Electroplate the fill, then stabilize grains and stress

body.zh: CMP + Cap；去除场区Cu，并封住互连顶部
body.en: CMP + cap Remove field Cu and seal the interconnect top

body.zh: Low-k介质；TaN（阻挡层）；Ta（衔接层）；Cu Seed（种子层）；ECP Cu（电镀铜）
body.en: Low-k dielectric TaN (barrier layer) Ta (transition layer) Cu seed (seed layer) ECP Cu (electroplated Cu)
Continuous barrier Barrier break: Cu may diffuse outward

body.zh: Seed连续；断种：局部无法起镀
body.en: Continuous seed Seed break: local plating cannot start
ECP fillability Fill failure: a void or seam forms

body.zh: 任何一环断开，最终都可能表现成高电阻或可靠性失效
body.en: A break anywhere in the chain can ultimately cause high resistance or reliability failure

title.zh: TaN、Ta、Cu Seed各司其职
title.en: TaN, Ta and Cu seed have distinct roles

subtitle.en: All precede Cu, but their barrier, interface and conduction tasks are not interchangeable

body.zh: Low-k / ILD；TaN（扩散阻挡层）；Ta（界面衔接层）；Cu Seed（导电种子层）；ECP Cu（主体填充）

body.zh: TaN |挡住Cu；阻止Cu向介质扩散，；关键是连续无针孔

body.zh: 2；Ta | 接好界面；改善TaN到Cu Seed；之间的界面衔接
body.en: 2 Ta | connect interfaces Improve the interface transition between TaN and Cu seed

body.zh: 3；Cu Seed；接通电流；为电镀提供连续；导电与起镀表面
body.en: 3 Cu seed Connect the current path Provide a continuous conductive surface for electroplating initiation

body.zh: 4；ECP Cu |；完成填充；形成互连的主体；导电体积
body.en: 4 ECP Cu | Complete the fill Form the main conductive volume of the interconnect

body.zh: Ta界面异常；附着 / 接触异常
body.en: Ta interface defect Adhesion / contact anomaly
Cu seed break Local plating does not start / void

body.zh: 经典层栈可简记：TaN挡、Ta接、Seed导、ECP填
body.en: Classic stack shorthand: TaN blocks; Ta connects; seed conducts; ECP fills

subtitle.en: From layout delivery to mask release in one diagram

body.zh: METAL；VIA；POLY；DIFF；WELL；.gds；GDS版图（设计数据）；数据处理与检查；.mdp；Reticle 光罩（成像数据）；投影到晶圆
body.en: METAL VIA POLY DIFF WELL .gds GDS layout (design data) Data processing and checks .mdp Reticle (imaging data) Projection onto the wafer

body.zh: 01；一句话定位|GDS是设计意图，JDV是写版确认；GDS表达设计师要做什么；JDV用于确认要写出的光罩是什么。
body.en: 01 In one sentence | GDS represents design intent; JDV confirms mask writing GDS describes what the designer wants; JDV confirms the mask to be written

body.zh: GDS（设计意图）；我要实现的电路；JDV（写版确认）；实际要写的光罩
body.en: GDS (design intent) The circuit to implement JDV (mask-writing verification) The actual mask to write

body.zh: 02；数据阶段|GDS在前，JDV接近Mask Release；GDS在Tape-out阶段输出；JDV通常出现在Mask Release前。
body.en: 02 Data stage | GDS comes first; JDV is close to mask release GDS is output at tape-out; JDV usually appears before mask release

body.zh: 设计；Design；验证；Sign-off；Tape-out；（GDS输出）；MDP制版；（数据处理）；Mask Release；（JDV）；.gds；.mdp
body.en: Design Design Verification Sign-off Tape-out (GDS output) MDP (data processing) Mask release (JDV) .gds .mdp

body.zh: 03；GDS装什么 |保存Cell、图形、层次与Layer；GDS以层次化方式保存几何图形及其所在Layer信息。
body.en: 03 What GDS contains | cells, shapes, hierarchy and layers GDS hierarchically stores geometric shapes and their layer information

body.zh: Cell层次树；Top Cell；Top Cell；Block A；Block B；Cell A1；Cell A2；Cell B1；Cell B2
body.en: Cell hierarchy Top cell Top cell Block A Block B Cell A1 Cell A2 Cell B1 Cell B2
Layer examples M1 VIA1 M2 POLY DIFF

body.zh: 04；JDV看什么 | 检查Mask、Reticle与Job信息；JDV关注成像数据本身及其在Reticle/Job中的完整性与一致性。
body.en: 04 What JDV checks | mask, reticle and job information JDV examines imaging data and its completeness and consistency within the reticle/job

body.zh: Reticle信息；尺寸、边框、对准标记、坐标原点
body.en: Reticle information Dimensions, frame, alignment marks and coordinate origin

body.zh: Mask图形；写入图形、层号、极性（Tone）
body.en: Mask shapes Written shapes, layer numbers and tone

body.zh: Job信息；工艺、机台、分辨率、焦深、批次
body.en: Job information Process, tool, resolution, depth of focus and lot

body.zh: 对比与一致性；MDP vs JDV、版本、校验和
body.en: Comparison and consistency MDP versus JDV, version and checksum

body.zh: 05；中间转换| GDS经过MDP才走到JDV；MDP将GDS转为面向写版的数据，并加入工艺与规则处理。
body.en: 05 Intermediate conversion | GDS passes through MDP before JDV MDP converts GDS into mask-writing data, adding process and rule handling

body.zh: MDP处理；规则检查；OPC/修饰；分块/分割；数据格式化
body.en: MDP processing Rule checks OPC / correction Partitioning / fracturing Data formatting

body.zh: .gds；设计数据；（GDS）；.mdp；写版数据；（MDP）；JDV查看；写版确认；（JDV）
body.en: .gds Design data (GDS) .mdp Mask-writing data (MDP) JDV viewing Mask-writing verification (JDV)

body.zh: 06；Review清单|版本、方向、Tone、Frame逐项确认；签核前按清单逐项确认，避免低级错误导致返工。
body.en: 06 Review checklist | verify version, orientation, tone and frame Confirm each checklist item before sign-off to prevent avoidable rework

body.zh: 版本一致；GDS/MDP/JDV 版本号匹配
body.en: Version consistency Matching GDS/MDP/JDV version numbers

body.zh: 方向与原点；旋转、镜像、原点位置正确
body.en: Orientation and origin Correct rotation, mirroring and origin

body.zh: Tone极性；正片/负片与工艺要求一致
body.en: Tone Positive/negative tone consistent with process requirements

body.zh: Frame与边界；写入边框、留白、禁写区
body.en: Frame and boundaries Write frame, blank margins and no-write areas

body.zh: 标记与对准；对准标记、测量标记完整
body.en: Marks and alignment Complete alignment and measurement marks

body.zh: 其它检查；Layer映射、校验和、注释
body.en: Other checks Layer mapping, checksum and annotations

body.zh: 07；正常差异 | OPC与Fracture会改变图形外观；为提升成像质量，OPC修饰与Fracture碎片化会改变外观但属正常。
body.en: 07 Normal differences | OPC and fracturing change shape appearance OPC correction and fracturing normally change appearance to improve imaging

body.zh: Pre-OPC；（设计图形）；OPC修饰；Post-OPC；（写版图形）
body.en: Pre-OPC (design shapes) OPC correction Post-OPC (mask-writing shapes)
Before fracturing (large shape) Fracturing After fracturing (partitioned shapes)

body.zh: 08；Release边界 | JDV签核不是万能验证；JDV仅验证写版数据是否正确，不能替代电性或良率验证。
body.en: 08 Release limits | JDV sign-off is not universal validation JDV verifies mask-writing data; it cannot replace electrical or yield validation

body.zh: JDV能保证（写版层面）；数据完整性与一致性；图形/层/极性正确；Reticle与Job信息正确；JDV SIGN-OFF
body.en: What JDV verifies (mask-writing level) Data completeness and consistency Correct shapes, layers and tone Correct reticle and job information JDV SIGN-OFF

body.zh: JDV不能保证（产品层面）；电路功能与时序正确；工艺良率与可靠性；封装/测试/系统问题
body.en: What JDV cannot guarantee (product level) Correct circuit function and timing Process yield and reliability Packaging / test / system issues

title.zh: 中间转换：GDS不能直接等于光罩
title.en: Intermediate conversion: GDS is not directly equivalent to a mask

subtitle.zh: 制造规则把设计数据变成可写、可检的Mask数据
subtitle.en: Manufacturing rules turn design data into writable, inspectable mask data

body.zh: Layer Map /；Boolean；层映射与；布尔运算
body.en: Layer map / Boolean Layer mapping and Boolean operations

body.zh: 3；Frame / Mark/；PCM；添加画框、标记；和工艺控制标记
body.en: 3 Frame / mark / PCM Add frames, marks and process-control marks

body.zh: Bias/ Shrink；尺寸修正；（偏置/收缩）
5；OPC/ MRC；光学临近校正；与规则检查
body.en: 5 OPC / MRC Optical proximity correction and rule checks

body.zh: Fracture /；Job Deck；MDP Job/Data；碎形处理并生成；MDP Job / Data
body.en: Fracture / job deck MDP job / data Fracture and generate MDP job / data

body.zh: JDV；版图预览；（写版验证视图）
GDS原始几何；Boolean结果；添加Frame/Mark；尺寸修正后；OPC校正后；Fracture结果；JDV预览
body.en: Original GDS geometry Boolean result Add frame/marks After size correction After OPC correction Fracturing result JDV preview

body.zh: Layer Mapping（层映射）；将设计层映射到工艺/掩膜层。
body.en: Layer mapping Map design layers to process/mask layers

body.zh: Boolean逻辑；按制造规则执行并/或/异或等布尔运算。
body.en: Boolean logic Apply manufacturing-rule Boolean operations such as AND, OR and XOR

body.zh: Bias / Shrink（偏置/收缩）；根据制造偏差对关键尺寸进行修正。
body.en: Bias / shrink Correct critical dimensions for manufacturing deviations

body.zh: OPC / Fracture；提升可印性并满足规则，最后进行碎形。
body.en: OPC / fracturing Improve printability and satisfy rules, then fracture the data

body.zh: 2. 耦合关系；OPC提高；可印性；增加Mask图形；复杂度；增加数据量与；写版时间
body.en: 2. Coupled effects OPC improves printability Increased mask-shape complexity Increased data volume and mask-writing time

body.zh: 更强的OPC改善印刷良率，但会带来复杂度和数据量的代价。
body.en: Stronger OPC can improve printing yield at the cost of complexity and data volume

body.zh: Boolean错误；布尔运算顺序或逻辑错误导致缺陷或开短路。
body.en: Boolean error Wrong operation order or logic can create defects, opens or shorts

body.zh: Tone反转；正/负片或极性设定错误，导致图形反相。
body.en: Tone inversion Wrong positive/negative tone or polarity inverts the pattern

body.zh: OPC层遗漏；未纳入关键OPC层或修正层，影响可印性。
body.en: Missing OPC layers Omitting critical OPC or correction layers affects printability

body.zh: Fracture异常；碎形缝隙、过大多边形或交叠异常等问题。
body.en: Fracturing anomaly Problems include gaps, oversized polygons or abnormal overlaps

body.zh: XOR（异或比较）；比较前后结果，检查意外差异。
body.en: XOR comparison Compare before and after to detect unintended differences

body.zh: MRC（制造规则检查）；对MDP数据执行制造规则检查。
body.en: MRC (manufacturing-rule check) Run manufacturing-rule checks on MDP data

body.zh: 独立转换检查；使用独立工具链或设置重复转换并比对。
body.en: Independent conversion check Repeat conversion with an independent toolchain or settings and compare

body.zh: 关键区域抽样；对关键区域/热点进行重点比对与验证。
body.en: Critical-region sampling Focus comparisons and validation on critical areas/hotspots

body.zh: 边界：并非所有层都采用相同的OPC、Bias或多重图形化规则。
body.en: Limit: not every layer uses the same OPC, bias or multiple-patterning rules

body.en: 1 Product name / revision / generation date Verify

Kerf（切割道）；晶圆切割预留槽
Mark（对准标记）；用于对准与套刻
body.en: Mark (alignment mark) Used for alignment and overlay

body.zh: PCM（工艺控制标记）；工艺监控与补偿
body.en: PCM (process-control mark) Process monitoring and compensation

body.zh: Dummy（填充）；均匀密度与工艺稳定
body.en: Dummy (fill) Uniform density and process stability

body.zh: OPC（光学邻近校正）；关键边缘修正
关键信息一致性；几何/层/标记检查
body.en: Consistency of key information Geometry / layer / mark checks

body.zh: 关键控制；版本唯一性；版本一致、来源清晰
body.en: Key controls Unique version Consistent version and clear provenance

body.zh: Mask完整性；层、标记、结构齐全
body.en: Mask completeness Complete layers, marks and structures

body.zh: 几何变换；方向、镜像、阵列正确
body.en: Geometric transforms Correct orientation, mirroring and array

body.zh: 工艺记录；参数、规则、日志完整
body.en: Process records Complete parameters, rules and logs

body.zh: 覆盖与效率；检查速度；覆盖度；检查速度与覆盖度；存在权衡
body.en: Coverage and efficiency Review speed Coverage Review speed and coverage involve a trade-off

body.zh: 常见风险；只看Die忽略Frame；Review错阶段；带未关闭Issue Release；版本混淆

body.zh: 反馈闭环；Checklist；按顺序逐项核对
body.en: Feedback loop Checklist Verify sequentially item by item

body.zh: 关键截图；支持定位与复现
body.en: Key screenshots Support localization and reproduction

body.zh: Owner与关闭状态；责任明确、闭环确认
body.en: Owner and closure status Clear responsibility and confirmed closure

body.zh: 边界：Review项目会随工艺节点、Tone和Lithography策略变化。

title.zh: 正常差异：图形不同不一定出错
title.en: Normal differences: different shapes do not necessarily mean an error

subtitle.zh: 比较前先确认：Pre-OPC还是Post-OPC？
subtitle.en: Before comparing, confirm: pre-OPC or post-OPC?

body.zh: Drawn GDS；规则直角；原始图形；设计工具绘制的；原始版图（规则直角）；EXPECTED
body.en: Drawn GDS Regular right angles Original pattern Drawn by design tools Original layout (regular right angles) EXPECTED

body.zh: Boolean；Derived Mask；经过布尔运算的；派生层；合并、相交、去边缘；清理等布尔运算后；的派生图形；EXPECTED
body.en: Boolean derived mask Derived layers after Boolean operations Derived shapes after union, intersection, edge cleanup and other Boolean operations EXPECTED

body.zh: Bias；Adjustment；轮廓均匀；扩张或收缩；按工艺Bias对轮廓；进行均匀扩张或；收缩（正/负Bias）；EXPECTED
body.en: Bias adjustment Uniform contour expansion or shrinkage Apply process bias to contours for uniform expansion or shrinkage (positive/negative bias) EXPECTED

body.zh: OPC Serif /；Hammerhead；角部Serif、线端；Hammerhead等修正；OPC在角部添加Serif，；线端添加Hammerhead；等，改善印刷性；EXPECTED
body.en: OPC serif / hammerhead Corner serifs and line-end hammerhead corrections OPC adds corner serifs and line-end hammerheads to improve printability EXPECTED

body.zh: Fracture；Primitives；拆成写版；基本图元；根据Writer规则将图形；fracture为写版可识别；的基本图元；EXPECTED
body.en: Fracture primitives Split into basic mask-writing primitives Fracture shapes per writer rules into writer-recognizable basic primitives EXPECTED

body.zh: JDV；Processed Pattern；写版视图中的；处理后图形；JDV（写版数据视图）；中的最终处理后；图形；EXPECTED
body.en: JDV processed pattern Processed pattern in the mask-writing view JDV (mask-writing data view) contains the final processed pattern EXPECTED

body.zh: 数据在各阶段的变化（从Pre-OPC到Post-JDV）
body.en: Data changes by stage (pre-OPC to post-JDV)

body.zh: 比较前先对齐；数据阶段；确认同为；Pre-OPC或；Post-OPC
body.en: Align before comparing Data stage Confirm both are pre-OPC or post-OPC

body.zh: 坐标系；单位、原点、；方向一致
body.en: Coordinate system Match units, origins and orientations

body.zh: Scale；Tone；倍率/缩放 正片/负片；一致；一致
body.en: Scale Tone Match magnification/scaling and positive/negative tone Consistent Consistent
Bias Match bias direction and value

body.zh: 判断权衡；过度要求逐点相同；会制造假警报；不同阶段图形本就会不同，；XOR大不一定有错
body.en: Judgment trade-off Demanding pointwise identity creates false alarms Shapes naturally differ across stages; a large XOR does not necessarily mean an error

body.zh: 盲目信任差异也可能；漏掉真实转换错误；转换逻辑/设置出错时，；差异可能被掩盖
body.en: Blindly trusting differences can also miss real conversion errors If conversion logic/settings are wrong, differences can be hidden

body.zh: 常见误判；把OPC当错误；OPC修改属于预期差异
body.en: Common misjudgments Treating OPC as an error OPC changes are expected differences

body.zh: 遗漏图形没发现；未对齐或阈值不当导致漏检
body.en: Missing an omitted shape Misalignment or unsuitable thresholds cause missed detection

body.zh: Pre/Post混合比较；Pre-OPC数据；Post-OPC视图；阶段不同，差异巨大
body.en: Mixed pre/post comparison Pre-OPC data Post-OPC view Different stages produce large differences

body.zh: XOR基准错误；基准层或逻辑反了
body.en: Wrong XOR reference Reference layer or logic is reversed

body.zh: 正确反馈；XOR；同阶段XOR；在同一数据阶段、同一设置下比较XOR
body.en: Correct feedback XOR Same-stage XOR Compare XOR at the same data stage and with the same settings

body.zh: 关键结构抽样；对关键结构抽样核查，结合设计意图
body.en: Sample critical structures Review sampled critical structures against design intent

body.zh: 尺寸统计；CD/线宽、间距、孔径等分布对比
body.en: Dimension statistics Compare distributions of CD/linewidth, spacing and hole diameter

body.zh: Layer数量与面积统计；Layer数、面积、密度等整体统计
body.en: Layer-count and area statistics Overall layer count, area, density and related statistics

body.zh: 边界：合理差异会随工艺节点、Mask Writer和RET策略变化。
body.en: Limit: acceptable differences vary with process node, mask writer and RET strategy
