title.zh: 从 Wire Bond 到Flip Chip：连接走向芯片表面
title.en: From Wire Bond to Flip Chip: connections move onto the chip surface

subtitle.zh: 当I/O密度、速度和电流不断提升，连接方式从芯片边缘走向整个芯片表面
subtitle.en: As I/O density, speed and current increase, connections move from the chip perimeter to the entire surface

body.zh: 边缘焊线的时代 Wire Bond
body.en: The era of peripheral wire bonding: Wire Bond
• Peripheral chip pads connected by metal wires

body.zh: • 工艺成熟，成本和返修经验丰富
body.en: • Mature process with extensive cost and rework experience

body.zh: • 对许多低速、I/O数有限的器件导线长度不是首要矛盾
body.en: • For many low-speed devices with limited I/O counts, Wire length is not the primary limitation

body.zh: •旧路线不是落后，而是曾经正好满足产品的约束
body.en: • The earlier route was not obsolete; it met The product constraints of its time

body.zh: 端子数量增加（处理器、射频、高性能器件）
body.en: More terminals (processors, RF and high-performance devices)

body.zh: •导线从芯片边缘绕出，路径更长
body.en: • Wires emerge around the chip perimeter, creating longer paths

body.zh: • 电源噪声与信号完整性开始限制系统
body.en: • Power noise and signal integrity Begin to constrain the system

body.zh: 面阵连接的转向 Flip Chip
body.en: The shift to area arrays: Flip Chip

body.zh: • 凸点直接分布在芯片表面和基板之间
body.en: • Bumps lie directly between the chip surface and substrate

body.zh: • 连接不再只发生在四周，整个表面都可以布置I/O
body.en: • Connections are no longer confined to the perimeter; I/O Can be placed over the entire surface

body.zh: •低电感、高布线密度、取消焊线环高
body.en: • Low inductance, high routing density and no wire-loop height

body.zh: •这正是面阵互连进入高性能封装的原因
body.en: • This is why area-array interconnects entered high-performance packaging
The cost of a new process

body.zh: 芯片底填凸点 基板
•需要晶圆级凸点、对准、回流或热压装配
body.en: • Requires wafer-level bumps, alignment, And reflow or thermocompression assembly
• Underfill is often needed beneath the chip

body.zh: • 连接变短并不等于制造更简单
body.en: • Shorter connections do not mean simpler manufacturing

body.zh: • 细间距带来共面性、空洞、翘曲和可靠性问题
body.en: • Fine pitch brings coplanarity, void, warpage And reliability issues

body.zh: Wire Bond适合• 成本更重要•功耗更重要• I/O规模较小• 低速器件
body.en: Wire Bond Suited to • Greater emphasis on cost • Greater emphasis on power consumption • Smaller I/O scale • Low-speed devices

body.zh: Flip Chip更有优势• 高密度I/O•高速路径•更好信号完整性• 适合高性能器件
body.en: Flip Chip Advantages in • High-density I/O • High-speed paths • Better signal integrity • High-performance devices

body.zh: 封装路线不是按先进程度排队而是由信号、供电、面积、热和成本共同筛选
body.en: Packaging routes are not ranked simply by technological advancement They are selected by signal, power supply, area, heat and cost together

body.zh: 更高密度更好性能面向多样的产品需求
body.en: Higher density Better performance For diverse product requirements
Reorganization of the testing and materials chain

body.zh: 验证热路径和板级可靠性
body.en: Validate thermal paths and board-level reliability

body.zh: 更高的集成度也意味着更紧的共同窗口
body.en: Higher integration also means a tighter shared window

body.zh: 高密度连接把原本分散在芯片边缘的误差集中到凸点阵列、基板布线和装配对准的共同窗口里
body.en: High-density interconnections concentrate errors formerly distributed around the chip perimeter Into a shared window for the bump array, substrate routing and assembly alignment

body.zh: 凸点阵列需要晶圆级凸点、对准、回流或热压装配，芯片底部还常需要底填。图示顺序为：晶圆级凸点及凸点阵列 → 对准 → 回流或热压装配 → 底填。
body.en: Bump arrays require wafer-level bumping, alignment, and reflow or thermocompression assembly; underfill is often also needed beneath the die. The illustrated sequence is wafer-level bumping and the bump array → alignment → reflow or thermocompression assembly → underfill.

body.zh: 主剖面标出了芯片、底填与凸点。局部图分别展示对准剖面、共面性边界和底填空洞。对准图以左右箭头与虚线标示相对位置；共面性图以虚线和上下箭头标示边界；空洞图标出底填中的空洞。
body.en: The main cross-section labels the die, underfill and bumps. Enlarged views show alignment, coplanarity limits and underfill voids. Opposing arrows and dashed lines indicate relative alignment; a dashed line and vertical arrows indicate the coplanarity limit; the void illustration identifies voids in the underfill.

body.zh: 共面性要求更高 → 更易产生空洞 → 更容易翘曲 → 可靠性风险上升。翘曲与可靠性示意展示弯曲的芯片结构和可靠性问题。
body.en: Stricter coplanarity requirements → more readily formed voids → greater susceptibility to warpage → increased reliability risk. The warpage and reliability illustration shows a bowed die structure and reliability problems.

body.zh: 细间距使共面性控制更难，底填更易产生空洞，并可能引起翘曲，进而影响可靠性。
body.en: Finer pitch makes coplanarity harder to control and promotes underfill voids; it may also cause warpage and thus affect reliability.

title.zh: 连接路线的产品约束
title.en: Product constraints on interconnect selection

subtitle.zh: 由信号、供电、面积、热和成本共同决定
subtitle.en: Determined jointly by signal, power delivery, area, thermal requirements and cost

body.zh: 不同的产品目标决定不同的连接路线。图中产品约束的五个维度为：信号—高速路径；供电—电流传输；面积—封装大小；热—散热能力；成本—制造成本。
body.en: Different product objectives determine different interconnect choices. The five illustrated product constraints are signal—high-speed paths; power delivery—current transfer; area—package size; thermal—heat-removal capability; and cost—manufacturing cost.

body.zh: 适合成本、功耗和I/O规模更重要的产品。图示金线连接，并列出：成本更低、适合较大I/O规模、功耗友好。
body.en: Suitable when cost, power consumption and I/O count are more important. The source illustrates a gold-wire connection and lists lower cost, suitability for a larger I/O count, and power-friendly operation.

body.zh: 在高密度和高速路径上更有优势。图示焊球连接，并列出：高密度I/O、支持高速路径、散热更好。
body.en: More advantageous for high density and high-speed paths. The source illustrates a solder-ball connection and lists high-density I/O, support for high-speed paths, and better heat removal.

heading.zh: 关键变量如何影响选择

body.zh: 信号：高速路径更适合Flip Chip。供电：大电流需求倾向Flip Chip。面积：高密度封装倾向Flip Chip。热：散热要求高倾向Flip Chip。成本：成本敏感更适合Wire Bond。I/O：I/O规模更重要时更适合Wire Bond。
body.en: Signal: high-speed paths favor Flip Chip. Power delivery: high-current requirements favor Flip Chip. Area: high-density packaging favors Flip Chip. Thermal: high cooling requirements favor Flip Chip. Cost: cost-sensitive products favor Wire Bond. I/O: when I/O count is more important, Wire Bond is more suitable.

body.zh: 当成本、功耗和I/O规模更重要时，选择Wire Bond；当高密度和高速路径更重要时，选择Flip Chip。
body.en: Choose Wire Bond when cost, power consumption and I/O count are more important; choose Flip Chip when high density and high-speed paths are more important.

notes.zh: 原图对两种路线给出概括性比较，未提供定量边界或适用产品条件；此处忠实保留原图表述。
notes.en: The original gives a broad comparison without quantitative limits or specific product conditions; its statements are preserved faithfully here.

title.zh: 封装级联合验证
title.en: Package-level joint validation

subtitle.zh: 从凸点到板级可靠性，把电、热、力放在同一验证窗口中
subtitle.en: From bumps to board-level reliability, evaluate electrical, thermal and mechanical behavior within one validation window

body.zh: 封装 → 凸点 → 基板布线 → 装配对准 → 板级可靠性。任何一环失配都会阻断交付。
body.en: Packaging → bumps → substrate routing → assembly alignment → board-level reliability. A mismatch in any link blocks delivery.

body.zh: 依靠芯片边缘焊盘和金属线连接，成熟且灵活。图中标出芯片、Wire Bond与I/O。当I/O数、信号频率和供电电流上升时，导线长度、寄生电感和封装高度开始占用系统余量。
body.en: Wire bonding uses die-edge pads and metal wires and is mature and flexible. The illustration labels the die, Wire Bond and I/O. As I/O count, signal frequency and supply current increase, wire length, parasitic inductance and package height begin consuming system margins.

body.zh: 凸点连接封装与基板，传递电与热。凸点失配会导致电气或机械失效。
body.en: Bumps connect the package and substrate and transfer electricity and heat. Bump mismatch causes electrical or mechanical failure.

body.zh: 基板布线在基板内完成信号与电源分配，影响完整性与热扩散。布线失配会引入信号与供电问题。
body.en: Substrate routing distributes signals and power within the substrate and affects integrity and heat spreading. Routing mismatch introduces signal and power-delivery problems.

body.zh: 装配对准保证封装与基板的空间对准，建立可靠连接。对准失配会导致连接不良或开路。
body.en: Assembly alignment ensures spatial alignment between the package and substrate and establishes reliable connections. Alignment mismatch causes poor connections or opens.

body.zh: 热量从芯片经封装与基板传导，影响整机可靠性。热路径失配会引发过热与长期可靠性风险。
body.en: Heat conducts from the die through the package and substrate, affecting system reliability. Thermal-path mismatch causes overheating and long-term reliability risks.

body.zh: 电气性能、热管理和机械可靠性共同进入验证。任一环节失配 → 阻断交付；目标是系统稳定、整机可靠、成功交付。
body.en: Electrical performance, thermal management and mechanical reliability are validated together. Any link mismatches → delivery is blocked. The goals are a stable system, reliable complete system and successful delivery.

title.zh: 什么是芯片的Seal Ring？
title.en: What is a chip’s Seal Ring?

subtitle.zh: 一圈不起眼的“隐形城墙”，却守护着每一颗芯片的生死
subtitle.en: An inconspicuous “invisible wall” protects the survival of every chip

body.zh: Core：核心电路区。IO Ring：压焊块环。Seal Ring：密封环（本环）。Scribe Line：划片槽，即切割下刀的地方。
body.en: Core: core circuitry. I/O Ring: bond-pad ring. Seal Ring: the sealing ring discussed here. Scribe Line: the lane where the cutting blade passes.

body.zh: 图中核心电路区位于中心；蓝色IO Ring位于外围；橙色Seal Ring环绕其外；最外侧灰色虚线表示Scribe Line。
body.en: The core circuitry is at the center. The blue I/O Ring lies around it, the orange Seal Ring surrounds that, and the outer gray dashed outline represents the Scribe Line.

body.zh: Seal Ring位于核心电路与划片槽之间，从衬底一路叠到最顶层金属。
body.en: The Seal Ring lies between the core circuitry and the scribe lane and extends from the substrate through the top metal layer.

title.zh: 一圈从衬底叠到顶层金属的“城墙”
title.en: A “wall” stacked from the substrate to the top metal layer

subtitle.zh: 02 · 结构与作用
subtitle.en: 02 · Structure and functions

body.zh: Metal 顶层金属（铜）Via 通孔：连续长条相邻层错位排列Contact 接触孔P+ 有源区/硅衬底
body.en: Metal: top metal (copper) Via: continuous elongated openings Staggered between adjacent layers Contact P+ active region / silicon substrate

body.zh: 看版图：Diff、Contact、Via、Metal 所有层次叠加成的闭合环，几乎没有缺口。
body.en: In layout: Diff, Contact, Via and Metal at all levels Stack into a closed ring with almost no gaps.

body.zh: 看工艺：多层铜金属＋氧化层＋钝化层堆叠，像一圈致密的堤坝。
body.en: In the process: stacked copper metal layers, oxide layers and passivation, Like a dense embankment.

body.zh: 看位置：夹在核心电路与划片槽之间，与内部电路保持安全距离。
body.en: In location: between the core circuit and the scribe line, maintaining A safe distance from the internal circuitry.

body.zh: 电气上：通常整体接地（VSS），是芯片边缘的等电位环。
body.en: Electrically: usually grounded as a whole (VSS), forming an Equipotential ring at the chip edge.

body.zh: ① 挡住切割裂纹划片刀在环外下刀，应力与微裂纹被这圈“城墙”截停，不再向芯片内部蔓延。
body.en: ① Stop dicing cracks The saw cuts outside the ring. This “wall” stops stress and microcracks, Preventing them from propagating into the chip.

body.zh: ② 阻挡水汽与污染错位长条孔形成“迷宫”，潮气、离子难以从侧面断口侵入核心电路。
body.en: ② Block moisture and contamination Staggered elongated vias form a “maze,” making it difficult for moisture and ions to enter The core circuit through the cut sidewall.

body.zh: ③ 泄放静电切割摩擦产生的静电，就近被接地的环导入地网络，分摊对芯片本体的冲击。
body.en: ③ Discharge static electricity Static charge generated by dicing friction is routed into the ground network by the nearby grounded ring, Distributing the impact on the chip itself.

body.zh: ④ 屏蔽外部干扰整体接地的闭合环如同法拉第笼，衰减外部电磁与噪声对内部的耦合。
body.en: ④ Shield external interference The fully grounded closed ring acts like a Faraday cage, attenuating external electromagnetic and noise Coupling into the interior.

body.zh: 代价：多占约5%–8%芯片面积；回报：良率与长期可靠性显著提升。
body.en: Cost: about 5%–8% more chip area; return: significantly improved yield and long-term reliability.

body.zh: Seal Ring结构因工艺节点而异 · 设计须严格遵循Foundry设计规则
body.en: Seal Ring structures vary by process node; designs must strictly follow Foundry design rules

notes.zh: 原图给出的5%–8%面积代价及屏蔽作用是原文陈述，未附适用器件或工艺条件，不应视为通用设计保证。
notes.en: The source states a 5%–8% area cost and shielding effects without specifying device or process conditions; these are source claims, not universal design guarantees.

uncertain: 原图给出的5%–8%面积代价及屏蔽作用是原文陈述，未附适用器件或工艺条件，不应视为通用设计保证。

title.zh: Seal Ring、Guard Ring、划片槽
title.en: Seal Ring, Guard Ring and Scribe Line

subtitle.zh: 03 · 别搞混
subtitle.en: 03 · Do not confuse them

body.zh: 芯片最外圈，核心电路与划片槽之间，整颗 die 一圈
body.en: At the outermost chip perimeter, between the core circuit and scribe line, Surrounding the entire die

body.zh: Diff + Contact+各层 Via+各层Metal，全层次叠加的闭合环
body.en: Diff + Contact + Vias at all levels + Metal at all levels, Stacked into a closed ring

body.zh: 挡切割裂纹、防水汽污染、泄放静电、屏蔽外部干扰
body.en: Stop dicing cracks, block moisture and contamination, discharge Static electricity and shield external interference

body.zh: 电路内部，围在模块/器件周围（如模拟与数字模块之间）
body.en: Inside the circuit, around modules / devices (e.g. between analog and digital blocks)

body.zh: 通常只是衬底接触（P+）或Nwell 环，层次很少
body.en: Usually substrate contacts (P+) or An Nwell ring, with few layers

body.zh: 收集少数载流子、抑制闩锁、隔离模块间噪声
body.en: Collect minority carriers, suppress latch-up and isolate Noise between modules

body.zh: 相邻芯片之间的留白通道，不是任何芯片的一部分
body.en: A blank channel between adjacent chips, not Part of either chip

body.zh: 不做电路的切割留白区，常放工艺监控测试结构
body.en: A blank dicing region without circuitry, often containing Process-monitoring test structures

body.zh: 记忆法：Guard Ring 护的是电路内部的模块，Seal Ring 护的是整颗芯片的边缘；
body.en: Memory aid: Guard Ring protects internal circuit blocks; Seal Ring protects the edge of the entire chip;

body.zh: 而 Scribe Line 根本不长在芯片上——它是芯片与芯片之间、留给刀走的路。
body.en: Scribe Line is not on the chip at all—it is the path between chips reserved for cutting.

body.zh: 芯片科普 · Seal Ring · 收藏这篇，下次看版图不迷路
body.en: Chip knowledge · Seal Ring · Save this guide to navigate layouts next time

03 · Do not confuse them
Seal Ring, Guard Ring and Scribe Line
Seal Ring
Guard Ring
Scribe Line
Location
At the outermost chip perimeter, between the core circuit and scribe line,
Surrounding the entire die
Inside the circuit, around modules / devices
(e.g. between analog and digital blocks)
A blank channel between adjacent chips, not
Part of either chip
Composition
Diff + Contact + Vias at all levels + Metal at all levels,
Stacked into a closed ring
Usually substrate contacts (P+) or
An Nwell ring, with few layers
A blank dicing region without circuitry, often containing
Process-monitoring test structures
Function
Stop dicing cracks, block moisture and contamination, discharge
Static electricity and shield external interference
Collect minority carriers, suppress latch-up and isolate
Noise between modules
The wafer into individual dies
In one phrase
The chip’s “wall”
An “isolation strip” between circuits
“The cutting location”
